@@ -0,0 +1,221 @@
+"""Engine track copy line (docs/ENGINE-COMPETITION.md, "Reusing other entries (copy line)"; gate
+``engcomp.ENGINE_COPYLINE_START_UTC``, None = off).
+
+Ideas are free. Reusing another entry's code (source OR binaries) is allowed only when declared: the image carries the label
+``ai.reax.engine.parents`` (JSON ``[{"uid": 4, "digest": "<64 hex>", "files": ["/app/engine.py", ...]}]``). The entry then
+counts as derived and must beat every parent by the full challenger margin (engcomp.update_champion, ``state.derived``).
+Undeclared reuse found by review is a copy (``COPY/<digest>`` marker, see ``engreview.copy_marker``). The same owner (same
+coldkey, or a signed ownership proof) may reuse its own code. A component without published source stays award-gated
+(unpaid) until the source is published: that is the existing award gate and is not changed here.
+
+Why a label and not a commitment field: the chain's raw field is 128 bytes and an engine commitment already uses most of it
+(``reax-eng/1:<track>:<image>@sha256:<digest>``); the label sits in the image configuration, which is part of the digest, so
+the declaration is bound to exactly the image that is run and cannot be edited afterwards; the pre-run check
+(engreview.check_image_config) already reads the labels from ``docker image inspect``. This module is pure (no docker, no
+chain, no network).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping, Optional, Sequence
+
+PARENTS_LABEL = "ai.reax.engine.parents"
+OWNERSHIP_LABEL = "ai.reax.engine.ownership"  # JSON [{"parent_digest", "parent_hotkey", "signature"}]
+MAX_PARENTS = 8
+MAX_FILES_PER_PARENT = 2000
+MAX_LABEL_BYTES = 128 * 1024  # room for MAX_FILES_PER_PARENT paths of several parents
+MAX_LABEL_DEPTH = 4  # parents: list > object > files list is 3 deep; anything deeper is not ours
+_HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+
+VERDICT_DERIVED = "derived (declared)"
+VERDICT_COPY = "copy (undeclared)"
+VERDICT_SAME_OWNER = "same owner"
+VERDICT_INDEPENDENT = "independent"
+
+# File name suffixes of binaries without readable source (a shared object, a CUDA binary, ...).
+BINARY_SUFFIXES = (".so", ".cubin", ".fatbin", ".ptx", ".a", ".o", ".pyd", ".dll", ".dylib", ".bin", ".pyc")
+SOURCE_SUFFIXES = (".py", ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".cu", ".cuh", ".h", ".hpp", ".rs", ".go", ".triton", ".pyx")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Parent:
+    uid: int
+    digest: str
+    files: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+def _loads(value: str) -> Any:
+    """``json.loads`` for a label: nesting deeper than MAX_LABEL_DEPTH is rejected before the parser sees it (a long run
+    of ``[`` would otherwise raise RecursionError). Raises ValueError for anything that is not a usable document."""
+    depth, in_str, esc = 0, False, False
+    for ch in value:
+        if in_str:
+            in_str, esc = (not (ch == '"' and not esc)), (ch == "\\" and not esc)
+        elif ch == '"':
+            in_str = True
+        elif ch in "[{":
+            depth += 1
+            if depth > MAX_LABEL_DEPTH:
+                raise ValueError("label nested too deeply")
+        elif ch in "]}":
+            depth -= 1
+    try:
+        return json.loads(value)
+    except RecursionError:
+        raise ValueError("label nested too deeply") from None
+
+
+def file_declared(path: str, declared: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
+    """``path`` is named by a declaration: listed exactly, or under a listed directory prefix (an entry ending in "/")."""
+    decl = declared if isinstance(declared, (set, frozenset)) else set(declared)
+    return path in decl or any(d.endswith("/") and path.startswith(d) for d in decl)
+
+
+def parse_parents(value: Any) -> tuple[list[Parent], list[str]]:
+    """``(parents, problems)`` from the label value (a JSON string). A malformed entry is reported and skipped, never
+    guessed; no label (None / empty) = no declaration. A file entry ending in "/" is a directory prefix. Pure."""
+    if value is None or value == "":
+        return [], []
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value.encode("utf-8")) > MAX_LABEL_BYTES:
+        return [], ["parents label is not a string or is larger than 128 KiB"]
+    try:
+        raw = _loads(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return [], ["parents label is not valid JSON"]
+    if not isinstance(raw, list):
+        return [], ["parents label must be a JSON list"]
+    parents: list[Parent] = []
+    problems: list[str] = []
+    for i, item in enumerate(raw[:MAX_PARENTS]):
+        uid, digest, files = (item.get("uid"), item.get("digest"), item.get("files")) if isinstance(item, dict) else (None,) * 3
+        if not (isinstance(uid, int) and not isinstance(uid, bool) and uid >= 0 and isinstance(digest, str)
+                and _HEX64.match(digest) and isinstance(files, list) and files
+                and all(isinstance(f, str) and f.startswith("/") and f != "/" and ".." not in f.split("/") for f in files)):
+            problems.append(f"parents[{i}] needs uid, a 64-hex digest and a non-empty list of absolute file paths "
+                            "(a directory prefix ends in \"/\")")
+            continue
+        if len(set(files)) > MAX_FILES_PER_PARENT:
+            problems.append(f"parents[{i}] lists more than {MAX_FILES_PER_PARENT} files; list directory prefixes instead")
+            continue
+        parents.append(Parent(uid, digest, tuple(sorted(set(files)))))
+    if len(raw) > MAX_PARENTS:
+        problems.append(f"more than {MAX_PARENTS} parents declared; the rest is ignored")
+    return parents, problems
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ same owner
+def ownership_message(parent_hotkey: str, child_hotkey: str, parent_digest: str) -> str:
+    """The text the PARENT's hotkey signs (sr25519) to hand its code to ``child_hotkey``. The child's image carries the
+    signature in the label ``ai.reax.engine.ownership``; the parent digest is the one named in the parents label."""
+    return f"reax-eng/1 same-owner:{parent_hotkey}>{child_hotkey}:{parent_digest}"
+
+
+Verifier = Callable[[str, str, str], bool]  # (ss58 address, message, hex signature) -> valid
+
+
+def sr25519_verifier() -> Optional[Verifier]:
+    """A verifier built on ``bittensor.sp_core.verify`` (the primitive behind ``bittensor.http_auth``, which auth.py uses for
+    the miner exchange), or None when the chain libraries are not installed (every proof is then rejected, never guessed)."""
+    try:
+        from bittensor import sp_core  # type: ignore
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - optional dependency
+        return None
+
+    def verify(address: str, message: str, signature_hex: str) -> bool:

+# the date (set in the release notes) everything below is unused: None = today's rule bit for bit. Validators must agree,
+# so there is no environment override.
+COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC: Optional[datetime] = datetime(2026, 10, 23, 13, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+# Slots of one coldkey in one pool that keep their whole score, and the factor per slot after them.
+COLDKEY_FREE_SLOTS = 2
+COLDKEY_DR_RATIO = 0.7
+# The tier-order cap runs at this ratio while the rule is active (the order_ratio brake is replaced, not stacked).
+COLDKEY_DR_ORDER_RATIO = 1.0
+# Pools the factors apply to: the small tiers only. In s1-fast / s1-pro pay is linear in verified throughput, and the big
+# coldkeys there sit at the per-hotkey cap (real capacity, not split machines). All four pools = the wider variant.
+COLDKEY_DR_POOLS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"s1-lite", "s1-cpu"})

+    """True from ``COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC`` on (the start instant itself counts); never without a date or a clock."""
+    return COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC is not None and now is not None and now >= COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC
+
+
+def coldkey_factor(k: int, free: Optional[int] = None, ratio: Optional[float] = None) -> float:
+    """Factor of the k-th (1-based, best score first) slot of one coldkey in one pool: 1 up to ``free`` slots,
+    ``ratio ** (k - free)`` after them (defaults: the release constants, read at call time)."""
+    free = COLDKEY_FREE_SLOTS if free is None else free
+    ratio = COLDKEY_DR_RATIO if ratio is None else ratio
+    return 1.0 if k <= free else ratio ** (k - free)
+

+def coldkey_factors(scores: Mapping[int, float], coldkey_of: Optional[Mapping[int, str]],
+                    free: Optional[int] = None, ratio: Optional[float] = None) -> dict[int, float]:
+    """Factor per slot of one pool. Slots are grouped by coldkey and ranked by score (best first, ties by slot id);
+    rank k gets ``coldkey_factor(k)``. A slot whose coldkey is unknown counts as its own coldkey (factor 1: honest
+    miners are never cut because of a missing metagraph row)."""
+    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}

+"""Award-time DI-proxy check: paired diff, SE, refusals, determinism, weighting."""

+def items(scores, unit_of=lambda i: "a" if i % 2 == 0 else "b", protocol="native"):
+    return {f"i{i}": {"stratum": unit_of(i), "score": float(s), "protocol": protocol} for i, s in enumerate(scores)}
+
+
+def write(path, d, field="unit"):
+    path.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps({"id": k, field: v["stratum"], "weight_group": "g", "score": v["score"],
+                                          "protocol": v["protocol"]}) for k, v in d.items()) + "\n")
+
+
+def test_identical_inputs_zero_diff():
+    c = items([1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0])
+    r = P.compute(c, dict(c))
+    assert r["diff"] == 0 and r["se"] == 0 and r["score"] == r["base_score"]

+
+def test_known_shift_exact():
+    base = items([0.5] * 10)
+    cand = items([0.6] * 10)

+    b = rng.integers(0, 2, 400)

+    cand, base = items(c, lambda i: "a"), items(b, lambda i: "a")
+    d = (c - b).astype(float)
+    expect = 100 * math.sqrt(d.var(ddof=1) / 400)
+    r = P.compute(cand, base)
+    assert r["se"] == pytest.approx(expect, abs=0.01)
+    boot = 100 * P.bootstrap_se(["a"] * 400, d, {"a": 1.0})
+    assert boot == pytest.approx(expect, rel=0.1)
+    assert r["se"] >= round(min(expect, boot), 4)

+    env.cfg.tracks = (dataclasses.replace(C.DEFAULT_TRACKS[0], end_ts=T0 + close_in_h * H),)

+    return env

+    assert M.confirm_due_ts(t, 12 * H, end, t) == end - LEAD               # the boundary instant: new

+    assert M.confirm_due_ts(now, 12 * H, now + 18 * H, now) == now + 12 * H               # exactly lead + delay: equal
+    assert M.confirm_due_ts(now, 12 * H, now + 8 * H, now) == now + 2 * H                 # 8 h before the close
+    assert M.confirm_due_ts(now, 12 * H, now + 2 * H, now) == now                         # inside the lead: at once
+    assert M.confirm_due_ts(now, 12 * H, now - H, now) == now                             # after the close: never earlier than the first pass

+    assert mean == pytest.approx(1.5)
+    assert se == pytest.approx(math.sqrt((1.2 ** 2 + 0.4 ** 2) / 2) / math.sqrt(2))
+    assert se == pytest.approx(0.5 * math.sqrt(1.2 ** 2 + 0.4 ** 2))
+    # it is the SE of the plain mean of two independent draws with those SEs, so pooling stays valid across sizes
+    assert M.pooled([3.0], [0.4]) == (3.0, 0.4)
+
+
+def test_evaluator_draw_size_follows_the_draw_time(gated):
+    ev = E.SpecEvaluator.__new__(E.SpecEvaluator)
+    ev.cfg = types.SimpleNamespace(sample_size=S.SAMPLE_SIZE)
+    assert [ev._draw_n("generalist", t) for t in (TS - 1, TS, TS + 1)] == [300, 900, 900]
+    assert [ev._draw_n("demand_forecasting", t) for t in (TS - 1, TS, TS + 1)] == [300, 300, 300]
+
+
+def test_margin_floor_v4_is_generalist_only(gated):
+    # the specialist tracks keep their published 1.5 floor after the gate (lead review: specialist DF/RA are not part of 3a)
+    ev = E.SpecEvaluator.__new__(E.SpecEvaluator)
+    assert ev._margin_now("generalist", TS + 1) == TS + 1
+    assert ev._margin_now("demand_forecasting", TS + 1) is None
+    assert M.margin_floor(ev._margin_now("generalist", TS + 1)) == M.MARGIN_FLOOR_V4
+    assert M.margin_floor(ev._margin_now("risk_assessment", TS + 1)) == M.MARGIN_FLOOR
+    assert M.required_margin(0.3, ev._margin_now("risk_assessment", TS + 1)) == M.MARGIN_FLOOR
+
+
+def test_dryrun_cli_per_category(tmp_path):
+    rows = pool(per_cat=200)
+    for row in rows:
+        row["state"] = {"secret": "PRIVATE_ITEM_TEXT"}
+    path = tmp_path / "pool.jsonl"
+    path.write_text("\n".join(map(json.dumps, rows)))
+    tool = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "generalist_draw_dryrun.py"
+
+    def run(*extra):
+        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tool), str(path), "--pairs", "1", *extra], capture_output=True, text=True)
+        assert res.returncode == 0, res.stderr
+        assert "PRIVATE_ITEM_TEXT" not in res.stdout + res.stderr
+        return json.loads(res.stdout)
+
+    base, v4 = run(), run("--per-category", "90")
+    assert base == run("--per-category", "30")   # default = the live constant
+    assert base["pairs_possible"] == v4["pairs_possible"] == 1 and v4["draws_possible"] == 2
+    thin = tmp_path / "thin.jsonl"
+    thin.write_text("\n".join(map(json.dumps, pool(per_cat=100))))
+    res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tool), str(thin), "--pairs", "1", "--per-category", "90"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert res.returncode == 0 and json.loads(res.stdout)["pairs_possible"] == 0   # a pool too thin for 90: reported, not a crash
+    bad = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(tool), str(path), "--per-category", "0"], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert bad.returncode == 2

@@ -0,0 +1,1020 @@
+"""Engine copy line (gate ``engcomp.ENGINE_COPYLINE_START_UTC``; docs/ENGINE-COMPETITION.md, "Reusing other entries").
+
+Rule points: (1) ideas are free = no effect; (2) declared reuse -> derived, must beat every parent by the full margin;
+(3) closed binaries are treated like source but stay award-gated; (4) undeclared reuse found by review = copy, strike, the
+second pauses the hotkey 7 days; (5) same owner reuses freely. Each behaviour is checked off (None), before, after, and at
+the boundary instant."""
+
+import asyncio
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import pytest
+
+from reax_subnet import engcomp as EC
+from reax_subnet import engcopyline as CL
+from reax_subnet import engreview
+from reax_subnet import engvalidator as EV
+from reax_subnet.engcomp import Champion, EvalResult, TrackState
+from test_engcomp import P
+from test_engfair import DA, DB, DC, REF, Gate, _ok, _res, _snap, _sub
+
+START = datetime(2026, 10, 25, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+SEC = timedelta(seconds=1)
+D1, D2 = "1" * 64, "2" * 64
+MARGIN = max(P.margin, EC.required_engine_margin(P.reference_noise_std))
+
+
+def _gate(monkeypatch, value):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(EC, "ENGINE_COPYLINE_START_UTC", value)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ gate
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("start,now,expected", [
+    (None, START, False),
+    (START, START - SEC, False),
+    (START, START, True),            # the boundary instant counts
+    (START, START + SEC, True),
+])
+def test_gate(monkeypatch, start, now, expected):
+    _gate(monkeypatch, start)
+    assert EC.copyline_active(now) is expected
+
+
+def test_release_constant_is_t1():
+    assert EC.ENGINE_COPYLINE_START_UTC == datetime(2026, 10, 23, 13, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)  # rc11
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ label parsing (point 2)
+def _label(*items):
+    return json.dumps([{"uid": u, "digest": d, "files": f} for u, d, f in items])
+
+
+def test_parse_parents_ok():
+    parents, problems = CL.parse_parents(_label((4, D1, ["/app/b.py", "/app/a.so", "/app/a.so"])))
+    assert problems == [] and parents == [CL.Parent(4, D1, ("/app/a.so", "/app/b.py"))]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["not json", "{}", '[{"uid": 4}]', _label((4, "xx", ["/a"])), _label((4, D1, [])),
+                                 _label((4, D1, ["rel/path"])), _label((4, D1, ["/a/../b"])),
+                                 json.dumps([{"uid": True, "digest": D1, "files": ["/a"]}])])
+def test_parse_parents_rejects_malformed(bad):
+    parents, problems = CL.parse_parents(bad)
+    assert parents == [] and problems
+
+
+def test_parse_parents_absent_is_no_declaration():
+    assert CL.parse_parents(None) == ([], []) and CL.parse_parents("") == ([], [])
+
+
+def test_parse_parents_caps():
+    items = [(i, f"{i:064x}", ["/a"]) for i in range(CL.MAX_PARENTS + 2)]
+    parents, problems = CL.parse_parents(_label(*items))
+    assert len(parents) == CL.MAX_PARENTS and problems
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ verdicts (points 2, 3, 5)
+def test_verdict_independent_when_nothing_shared():
+    assert CL.verdict([], {D1: []}) == (CL.VERDICT_INDEPENDENT, {D1: CL.VERDICT_INDEPENDENT})
+
+
+def test_verdict_declared_reuse_is_derived_source_and_binary():
+    v, per = CL.verdict([D1], {D1: ["/app/a.py", "/app/lib.so"]}, declared_files={D1: ["/app/a.py", "/app/lib.so"]})
+    assert v == CL.VERDICT_DERIVED and per[D1] == CL.VERDICT_DERIVED  # binaries are treated like source
+
+
+def test_verdict_undeclared_is_copy_and_beats_derived():
+    assert CL.verdict([], {D1: ["/app/lib.so"]})[0] == CL.VERDICT_COPY
+    v, per = CL.verdict([D1], {D1: ["/a.py"], D2: ["/b.so"]}, declared_files={D1: ["/a.py"]})
+    assert v == CL.VERDICT_COPY and per == {D1: CL.VERDICT_DERIVED, D2: CL.VERDICT_COPY}
+
+
+def test_verdict_declared_parent_but_extra_files_is_copy():
+    assert CL.verdict([D1], {D1: ["/a.py", "/b.so"]}, declared_files={D1: ["/a.py"]})[0] == CL.VERDICT_COPY
+
+
+def test_verdict_same_owner_reuses_freely():
+    assert CL.verdict([], {D1: ["/a.so"]}, same_owner=[D1]) == (CL.VERDICT_SAME_OWNER, {D1: CL.VERDICT_SAME_OWNER})
+
+
+def test_constraint_parents_leave_out_same_owner():
+    assert CL.constraint_parents([D2, D1], [D1], [D2]) == [D1]
+
+
+def test_closed_components_by_missing_source():
+    files = ["/app/engine.py", "/app/fast.so", "/app/fast.cu", "/app/closed.so", "/app/k.cubin", "/app/README.md"]
+    assert CL.closed_components(files) == ["/app/closed.so", "/app/k.cubin"]
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ same owner
+def test_same_coldkey():
+    ck = {"hk1": "ck", "hk2": "ck", "hk3": "other"}
+    assert CL.same_coldkey("hk1", "hk2", ck) and not CL.same_coldkey("hk1", "hk3", ck)
+    assert not CL.same_coldkey("hk1", "unknown", ck) and not CL.same_coldkey("x", "y", {})
+
+
+def test_ownership_proof_binds_parent_digest_and_child_hotkey():
+    msg = CL.ownership_message("parent_hk", "child_hk", D1)
+    assert msg == f"reax-eng/1 same-owner:parent_hk>child_hk:{D1}"
+    seen = []
+
+    def verify(addr, message, sig):
+        seen.append((addr, message))
+        return sig == "good"
+    label = json.dumps([{"parent_digest": D1, "parent_hotkey": "parent_hk", "signature": "good"}])
+    assert CL.valid_ownership_proof(label, D1, "parent_hk", "child_hk", verify)
+    assert seen == [("parent_hk", msg)]
+    bad = json.dumps([{"parent_digest": D1, "parent_hotkey": "parent_hk", "signature": "forged"}])
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof(bad, D1, "parent_hk", "child_hk", verify)
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof(label, D2, "parent_hk", "child_hk", verify)      # another parent digest
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof(label, D1, "parent_hk", "child_hk", None)        # no chain library: no proof
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof("junk", D1, "parent_hk", "child_hk", verify)
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ margin vs parents (point 2)
+def _state(parent_score, child_score, champion=None, parent_ok=True):
+    st = TrackState()
+    st.results[D1] = EvalResult(D1, "s1-fast", parent_ok, score=parent_score, block=100, session="p")
+    st.results[D2] = EvalResult(D2, "s1-fast", True, score=child_score, block=200, session="c")
+    st.first_seen = {D1: (100, "pa"), D2: (200, "ch")}
+    st.champion = champion
+    return st
+
+
+SUBS = [_sub(1, "pa", D1, 100), _sub(2, "ch", D2, 200)]
+
+
+def _two_sessions(st, copyline):
+    EC.update_champion(st, SUBS, P, 3000, copyline=copyline)
+    st.results[D2] = EvalResult(D2, "s1-fast", True, score=st.results[D2].score, block=300, session="c2")
+    return EC.update_champion(st, SUBS, P, 3100, copyline=copyline)
+
+
+def test_parent_bar_values():
+    st = _state(1.5, 1.6)
+    assert EC.parent_bar(st, D2, MARGIN) == 0.0                  # no parents
+    st.derived[D2] = [D1]
+    assert EC.parent_bar(st, D2, MARGIN) == pytest.approx(1.5 * (1 + MARGIN))
+    st.hold(st.results[D1])
+    st.results[D1] = EvalResult(D1, "s1-fast", False, score=9.0, block=100)
+    assert EC.parent_bar(st, D2, MARGIN) == pytest.approx(1.5 * (1 + MARGIN))   # a failed re-run does not lower the bar
+    st.held_scores[D1] = 1.7                                     # nor does a lower later score (held survives)
+    assert EC.parent_bar(st, D2, MARGIN) == pytest.approx(1.7 * (1 + MARGIN))
+
+
+def test_derived_entry_must_beat_parent_by_full_margin():
+    # no champion: the child clears the reference bar but not parent x (1 + margin)
+    st = _state(1.5, 1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) - 0.001)
+    st.derived[D2] = [D1]
+    ch = _two_sessions(st, True)
+    assert ch is None or ch.digest != D2
+
+
+def test_derived_entry_crowned_when_it_beats_parent_by_margin():
+    st = _state(1.5, 1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) + 0.01)
+    st.derived[D2] = [D1]
+    ch = _two_sessions(st, True)
+    assert ch is not None and ch.digest == D2
+
+
+def test_parent_rule_ignored_before_gate():
+    # same numbers, copyline False (gate off / before the date): the derived record changes nothing
+    st = _state(1.5, 1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) - 0.001)
+    st.derived[D2] = [D1]
+    off = _two_sessions(st, False)
+    st2 = _state(1.5, 1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) - 0.001)
+    ref = _two_sessions(st2, False)
+    assert (off.digest if off else None) == (ref.digest if ref else None)
+
+
+def test_confirmation_must_clear_parent_bar_in_every_session():
+    st = _state(1.5, 1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) + 0.01)
+    st.derived[D2] = [D1]
+    EC.update_champion(st, SUBS, P, 3000, copyline=True)
+    assert st.challenger is not None and st.challenger["digest"] == D2
+    st.results[D2] = EvalResult(D2, "s1-fast", True, score=1.5 * (1 + MARGIN) - 0.001, block=300, session="c2")
+    ch = EC.update_champion(st, SUBS, P, 3100, copyline=True)
+    assert ch is None or ch.digest != D2
+    assert st.challenger is None or st.challenger["digest"] != D2    # the parent may be the challenger, the child no longer
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ strikes and pause (point 4)
+def test_first_strike_no_pause_second_pauses_seven_days():
+    st = TrackState()
+    assert st.record_copy("hk", D1, 1000) == 1
+    assert not st.copy_paused("hk", 1000) and st.copy_paused_until == {}
+    assert st.record_copy("hk", D1, 1001) == 1                   # same digest: counted once
+    assert st.record_copy("hk", D2, 2000) == 2
+    until = 2000 + EC.ENGINE_COPYLINE_PAUSE_BLOCKS
+    assert EC.ENGINE_COPYLINE_PAUSE_BLOCKS == 50400 and st.copy_paused_until == {"hk": until}
+    assert st.copy_paused("hk", until - 1) and not st.copy_paused("hk", until)   # boundary block
+    assert not st.copy_paused("other", 2001)
+    assert st.record_copy("hk", DC, 3000) == 3                   # every later one pauses again (F6)
+    assert st.copy_paused_until == {"hk": 3000 + EC.ENGINE_COPYLINE_PAUSE_BLOCKS}
+    st.copy_paused_until["hk"] = 10 ** 9                         # never shortens a longer running pause
+    st.record_copy("hk", "9" * 64, 3100)
+    assert st.copy_paused_until == {"hk": 10 ** 9}
+
+
+def test_state_roundtrip_add_only():
+    st = TrackState()
+    assert not {"copy_strikes", "copy_paused_until", "derived", "derived_hk", "held_scores"} & set(st.to_json())   # absent while empty: rollback-safe
+    st.record_copy("hk", D1, 10)
+    st.record_copy("hk", D2, 20)
+    st.derived[DC] = [D1]
+    st.derived_hk[DC] = {D1: ["pa"]}
+    st.hold(EvalResult(D1, "s1-fast", True, score=1.5, block=1))
+    back = TrackState.from_json(json.loads(json.dumps(st.to_json())))
+    assert back.copy_strikes == {"hk": [D1, D2]} and back.copy_paused_until == st.copy_paused_until
+    assert back.derived == {DC: [D1]} and back.derived_hk == {DC: {D1: ["pa"]}} and back.held_scores == {D1: 1.5}
+    old = TrackState.from_json({"results": {}})                   # a file from the live build
+    assert old.copy_strikes == {} and old.derived == {}
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ validator wiring
+class FakeRunner:
+    binds_hotkey = False
+
+    def __init__(self, review_dir):
+        self.review_dir = review_dir
+
+
+def _comp(tmp_path, runner=None, now=START + SEC):
+    comp = EV.EngineCompetition(runner or FakeRunner(str(tmp_path / "rev")), {"s1-fast": REF}, str(tmp_path / "s.json"),
+                                tracks={"s1-fast": P}, start_utc=None, utcnow=lambda: now)
+    return comp
+
+
+def _mark_copy(tmp_path, digest):
+    os.makedirs(tmp_path / "rev" / "COPY", exist_ok=True)
+    (tmp_path / "rev" / "COPY" / digest).write_text("")
+
+
+def test_copy_marker_is_regular_file_only(tmp_path):
+    rd = str(tmp_path / "rev")
+    assert not engreview.copy_marker(rd, D1)
+    _mark_copy(tmp_path, D1)
+    assert engreview.copy_marker(rd, D1) and not engreview.copy_marker(rd, D2) and not engreview.copy_marker(rd, "bad")
+    os.symlink("/etc/passwd", tmp_path / "rev" / "COPY" / D2)
+    assert not engreview.copy_marker(rd, D2)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("start,now,counts", [
+    (None, START, False), (START, START - SEC, False), (START, START, True), (START, START + SEC, True)])
+def test_copy_marker_effect_follows_gate(monkeypatch, tmp_path, start, now, counts):
+    _gate(monkeypatch, start)
+    _mark_copy(tmp_path, D1)
+    comp = _comp(tmp_path, now=now)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    res = asyncio.run(comp._evaluate_one(st, "s1-fast", P, _sub(1, "hk", D1, 100), 500))
+    if counts:
+        assert isinstance(res, EvalResult) and not res.ok and res.reason.startswith("copy:")
+        assert st.copy_strikes == {"hk": [D1]}
+    else:
+        assert st.copy_strikes == {} and not (isinstance(res, EvalResult) and res.reason.startswith("copy:"))
+
+
+def test_second_copy_pauses_and_paused_hotkey_is_not_evaluated(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    _gate(monkeypatch, START)
+    comp = _comp(tmp_path)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    for d in (D1, D2):
+        _mark_copy(tmp_path, d)
+        asyncio.run(comp._evaluate_one(st, "s1-fast", P, _sub(1, "hk", d, 100), 500))
+    assert st.copy_paused("hk", 501)
+    tried = []
+
+    async def fake_eval(st_, track, params, sub, block):
+        tried.append(sub.uid)
+        return None
+    comp._evaluate_one = fake_eval
+    subs = [_sub(1, "hk", DA, 100), _sub(2, "other", DB, 100)]
+    asyncio.run(comp.run_cycle(_snap(subs, block=1000), set()))
+    assert tried == [2]                                         # uid 1's hotkey is paused
+    tried.clear()
+    asyncio.run(comp.run_cycle(_snap(subs, block=500 + EC.ENGINE_COPYLINE_PAUSE_BLOCKS), set()))
+    assert sorted(tried) == [1, 2]                              # the pause ended at its boundary block
+
+
+def test_pause_not_applied_when_gate_off(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    _gate(monkeypatch, None)
+    comp = _comp(tmp_path)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    st.copy_paused_until["hk"] = 10 ** 9                        # even a leftover record changes nothing while off
+    tried = []
+
+    async def fake_eval(st_, track, params, sub, block):
+        tried.append(sub.uid)
+    comp._evaluate_one = fake_eval
+    asyncio.run(comp.run_cycle(_snap([_sub(1, "hk", DA, 100)], block=1000), set()))
+    assert tried == [1]
+
+
+def _record(tmp_path, digest, parents_label, ownership_label=None):
+    rec = engreview.new_record("img@sha256:" + digest, digest, [], [], {}, {})
+    rec["copyline"] = 1
+    if parents_label is not None:
+        rec["parents_label"] = parents_label
+    if ownership_label:
+        rec["ownership_label"] = ownership_label
+    engreview.write_record(str(tmp_path / "rev"), digest, rec)
+
+
+def test_refresh_derived_declared_parent_and_same_coldkey(tmp_path):
+    comp = _comp(tmp_path)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    st.first_seen = {D1: (100, "pa"), D2: (200, "ch"), DC: (300, "pb")}
+    _record(tmp_path, D2, _label((1, D1, ["/app/a.py"]), (3, DC, ["/app/c.so"])))
+    subs = [_sub(1, "pa", D1, 100), _sub(2, "ch", D2, 200), _sub(3, "pb", DC, 300)]
+    snap = _snap(subs, coldkeys={1: "ckA", 2: "ckB", 3: "ckB"})   # uid 3 belongs to the child's owner
+    comp._refresh_derived(st, subs, snap)
+    assert st.derived == {D2: [D1]}                              # DC is the same owner: not a constraint
+    snap = _snap(subs, coldkeys={1: "ckB", 2: "ckB", 3: "ckB"})
+    comp._refresh_derived(st, subs, snap)
+    assert st.derived == {D2: []}                                # all parents are the same owner: read, no constraint
+
+
+def test_refresh_derived_signed_proof(tmp_path):
+    comp = _comp(tmp_path)
+    comp._verify_ownership = lambda addr, msg, sig: addr == "pa" and msg == CL.ownership_message("pa", "ch", D1)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    st.first_seen = {D1: (100, "pa")}
+    proof = json.dumps([{"parent_digest": D1, "parent_hotkey": "pa", "signature": "00"}])
+    _record(tmp_path, D2, _label((1, D1, ["/app/a.py"])), proof)
+    subs = [_sub(1, "pa", D1, 100), _sub(2, "ch", D2, 200)]
+    comp._refresh_derived(st, subs, _snap(subs, coldkeys={1: "ckA", 2: "ckB"}))
+    assert st.derived == {D2: []}
+
+
+def test_review_record_keeps_labels_complete():
+    long = _label(*[(i, f"{i:064x}", ["/app/" + "x" * 150 + ".py"]) for i in range(3)])
+    info = {"Config": {"Labels": {CL.PARENTS_LABEL: long, "other": "v"}}}
+    assert engreview.copyline_fields(info) == {"parents_label": long}
+    assert engreview.copyline_fields({"Config": {"Labels": {"other": "v"}}}) == {}
+    assert engreview.copyline_fields({}) == {}
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ operator tool
+def _tool():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "engine_parents_check", os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "tools", "engine_parents_check.py"))
+    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(m)
+    return m
+
+
+def _write(root, files):
+    for rel, data in files.items():
+        p = root / rel.lstrip("/")
+        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        p.write_bytes(data)
+
+
+def _trees(tmp_path, child, parent, base=None):
+    for name, files in (("child", child), ("parent", parent), ("base", base or {})):
+        (tmp_path / name).mkdir()
+        _write(tmp_path / name, files)
+    return [str(tmp_path / n) for n in ("child", "parent", "base")]
+
+

+def test_f4_real_sr25519_proof_verifies():
+    sp_core = pytest.importorskip("bittensor").sp_core
+    parent = sp_core.Keypair.create_from_mnemonic(sp_core.Keypair.generate_mnemonic())
+    child = sp_core.Keypair.create_from_mnemonic(sp_core.Keypair.generate_mnemonic())
+    verify = CL.sr25519_verifier()
+    assert verify is not None
+    msg = CL.ownership_message(parent.ss58_address, child.ss58_address, D1)
+    sig = parent.sign(msg.encode("utf-8")).hex()
+    label = json.dumps([{"parent_digest": D1, "parent_hotkey": parent.ss58_address, "signature": sig}])
+    ok = lambda ph=parent.ss58_address, ch=child.ss58_address, d=D1, lab=label: CL.valid_ownership_proof(lab, d, ph, ch, verify)
+    assert ok() and CL.valid_ownership_proof(label.replace(sig, "0x" + sig), D1, parent.ss58_address, child.ss58_address, verify)
+    assert not ok(ch=parent.ss58_address)                    # another child hotkey
+    assert not ok(d=D2) and not ok(lab=label.replace(D1, D2))   # another digest
+    assert not ok(ph=child.ss58_address)                     # signed by somebody else
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof(label.replace(sig, "00" * 64), D1, parent.ss58_address, child.ss58_address, verify)
+    assert not CL.valid_ownership_proof(label.replace(sig, "zz"), D1, parent.ss58_address, child.ss58_address, verify)

+# ---- G3: measured digests whose record predates the start are re-checked once, not dropped
+class RecheckRunner(FakeRunner):
+    def __init__(self, review_dir):
+        super().__init__(review_dir)
+        self.calls = []
+
+    async def recheck_copyline(self, ref):
+        self.calls.append(ref)
+        rec = engreview.load_record(self.review_dir, engreview.digest_of(ref))
+        if rec and not rec.get("copyline"):
+            rec["copyline"] = 1
+            engreview.write_record(self.review_dir, engreview.digest_of(ref), rec)
+
+
+def _old_record(tmp_path, digest):
+    rec = engreview.new_record("img@sha256:" + digest, digest, [], [], {}, {})   # no copyline mark: written before the start
+    engreview.write_record(str(tmp_path / "rev"), digest, rec)
+

+    _gate(monkeypatch, START)

+    comp = _comp(tmp_path, runner)
+    st = comp.states["s1-fast"]
+    _old_record(tmp_path, D2)
+    st.results[D2] = EvalResult(D2, "s1-fast", True, score=2.0, block=100, session="a")
+    subs = [_sub(2, "ch", D2, 100)]
+    st.first_seen[D2] = (100, "ch")
+    comp._refresh_derived(st, subs, _snap(subs))
+    assert D2 not in st.derived                                   # not read yet: not crownable (fail closed)
+    assert EC.update_champion(st, subs, P, 1000, copyline=True) is None
+    assert any(s.digest == D2 for s in subs)                      # still in the pool
+
+    async def fake_eval(st_, track, params, sub, block):
+        return EvalResult(sub.digest, track, True, score=2.0, block=block)
+    comp._evaluate_one = fake_eval
+    _cycle(comp, subs)
+    assert len(runner.calls) == 1 and st.derived[D2] == [] and st.champion.digest == D2
+    assert engreview.load_record(str(tmp_path / "rev"), D2)["copyline"] == 1   # marked: the runner's re-check is a no-op from now on

+"""Opening generalist cohort: playoff places 2 and 3 take the 17 % / 8 % former-champion slots
+(competition_split.OPENING_PLAYOFF_SLOTS_START_UTC; docs/GENERALIST-RELEASE.md, "Opening playoff slots")."""
+
+import copy
+import math
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import pytest
+from spec_helpers import commit, neuron, snapshot
+
+from reax_subnet import competition_split as CS
+from reax_subnet.competition_split import combine_weights
+from reax_subnet.spec import state as ST
+from reax_subnet.spec.evaluator import compute_leaders, opening_playoff_slots
+
+TRACK = "generalist"
+OPEN = CS.GENERALIST_START_UTC.timestamp()
+GATE = CS.GENERALIST_START_UTC + timedelta(hours=6)
+DAY = 86400.0
+BASE_ID = "81a3eb978ff3c5b90c273a100f36499a86dfec698652c2d181f43e11e89fe08d"      # floor 58.01
+NO_FLOOR_BASE = "f" * 64
+NEED = CS.KEEPALIVE_BASE_FLOOR[BASE_ID][TRACK] + CS.OPENING_PLAYOFF_BASE_MARGIN     # 59.51
+SERVING = {11: 0.6, 12: 0.4}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _gate(monkeypatch):

+
+
+def sub(uid, score, nonproc=None, *, status=ST.NOT_BETTER, crowned=None, base=BASE_ID, **kw):
+    key = f"{neuron(uid).hotkey}|{commit(TRACK, f'a/m{uid}')}"
+    s = ST.Submission(key=key, uid=uid, hotkey=neuron(uid).hotkey, coldkey=f"c{uid}", track_id=TRACK, repo=f"a/m{uid}",
+                      revision="a" * 40, first_seen_block=100 + uid, first_seen_ts=OPEN - 3600.0, status=status, score=score,
+                      champion_since_ts=crowned, base_id=base, delta_checked=True, **kw)
+    s.history.append({"draw": "d1", "kind": "playoff", "score": score, "field": 5,
+                      "nonproc": score - 1.0 if nonproc is None else nonproc, "by_tier": {}})
+    return s
+
+
+def make_state(*, play_ts=OPEN + 3600.0, crowned=None, subs=None):
+    """Winner uid 1 (70), place 2 uid 2 (66), place 3 uid 3 (62), place 4 uid 4 (61); one playoff draw d1."""
+    crowned = play_ts + 60.0 if crowned is None else crowned
+    subs = subs or [sub(1, 70.0, status=ST.CHAMPION, crowned=crowned), sub(2, 66.0), sub(3, 62.0), sub(4, 61.0)]
+    ts = ST.TrackState(TRACK, submissions={s.key: s for s in subs}, champion=subs[0].key)

+
+def view(uids=(1, 2, 3, 4)):

+
+
+def uids(state, now, **kw):
+    return [u for u, _ in compute_leaders(state, [TRACK], view(**kw), now=now)[TRACK]]
+
+
+T1 = OPEN + 3600.0 + 60.0 + 6 * DAY      # inside the window after a post-gate crowning

+def test_gate_none_is_bit_identical(monkeypatch):

+
+def test_places_two_and_three_take_the_former_champion_ranks():

+    assert res == [(1, 70.0), (2, 66.0), (3, 62.0)]                 # place 4 (uid 4) is not a slot
+    w = combine_weights(SERVING, None, 0.0, {TRACK: res}, now=POST + DAY)

@@ -0,0 +1,218 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Award-time Decision-Index-proxy check: paired candidate-vs-base numbers on the frozen house DI-proxy eval.
+
+Inputs are per-item JSONL results (id, unit|area, weight_group, score in [0,1], protocol) for the candidate and the
+official base on the SAME frozen eval. The tool refuses anything that is not a clean paired comparison and prints the
+"di_proxy" block (points on a 0-100 scale, 4 decimals) as JSON on stdout and a one-line summary on stderr.
+It only produces numbers; the pass/fail decision (lower90 >= -0.5) and the manual card on failure belong to the signer.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+Z90 = 1.2816  # one-sided 90 % normal quantile
+THRESHOLD = -0.5  # non-inferiority margin in points: lower90 = diff - Z90 * se must be >= this
+BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES = 2000
+
+
+class ProxyError(ValueError):
+    """The inputs are not a clean paired comparison; no numbers are produced."""
+
+
+def file_sha256(path) -> str:
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_items(path, stratum_field: str = "unit") -> dict:
+    """id -> {"stratum", "score", "protocol"}. Refuses duplicate ids, NaN/out-of-range scores, missing fields."""
+    out: dict = {}
+    for n, line in enumerate(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        try:
+            row = json.loads(line)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: invalid JSON ({e})") from None
+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: not an object")
+        iid = row.get("id")
+        if not isinstance(iid, str) or not iid:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: missing id")
+        if iid in out:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: duplicate id {iid!r}")
+        stratum = row.get(stratum_field)
+        if stratum is None and stratum_field == "unit":
+            stratum = row.get("area")  # `area` is accepted as the unit's alias
+        if not isinstance(stratum, str) or not stratum:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: missing {stratum_field} for {iid!r}")
+        score = row.get("score")
+        if isinstance(score, bool):
+            score = float(score)
+        if not isinstance(score, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(score):
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: score for {iid!r} is missing, NaN or not a number")
+        if not 0.0 <= score <= 1.0:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: score for {iid!r} outside [0, 1]")
+        protocol = row.get("protocol")
+        if not isinstance(protocol, str) or not protocol:
+            raise ProxyError(f"{path}:{n}: missing protocol for {iid!r}")
+        out[iid] = {"stratum": stratum, "score": float(score), "protocol": protocol}
+    if not out:
+        raise ProxyError(f"{path}: no items")
+    return out
+
+
+def pair_items(cand: dict, base: dict, eval_ids=None):
+    """Return (ids, strata, protocols, d) with d = candidate - base per item; refuses any set/unit/protocol mismatch."""
+    if set(cand) != set(base):
+        missing_c = sorted(set(base) - set(cand))[:3]
+        missing_b = sorted(set(cand) - set(base))[:3]
+        raise ProxyError(f"item sets differ (missing in candidate: {missing_c}; missing in base: {missing_b})")
+    if eval_ids is not None and set(cand) != set(eval_ids):
+        raise ProxyError("item set differs from the frozen eval file")
+    ids = sorted(cand)
+    for i in ids:
+        if cand[i]["stratum"] != base[i]["stratum"]:
+            raise ProxyError(f"unit differs between candidate and base for {i!r}")
+        if cand[i]["protocol"] != base[i]["protocol"]:
+            raise ProxyError(f"protocol differs between candidate and base for {i!r}")
+    strata = [cand[i]["stratum"] for i in ids]
+    protocols = [cand[i]["protocol"] for i in ids]
+    d = np.array([cand[i]["score"] - base[i]["score"] for i in ids], dtype=float)
+    return ids, strata, protocols, d
+
+
+def normalised_weights(strata_present, weights=None) -> dict:
+    """unit -> weight summing to 1. Default equal over the units present; a given table must cover exactly those units."""
+    units = sorted(set(strata_present))
+    if weights is None:
+        return {u: 1.0 / len(units) for u in units}
+    if set(weights) != set(units):
+        raise ProxyError(f"weight units {sorted(weights)} do not match item units {units}")
+    for u, w in weights.items():
+        if not isinstance(w, (int, float)) or isinstance(w, bool) or not math.isfinite(w) or w <= 0:
+            raise ProxyError(f"weight for {u!r} must be a positive finite number")
+    total = float(sum(weights.values()))
+    return {u: float(weights[u]) / total for u in units}
+
+
+def _groups(strata, values, weights):
+    by: dict = {}
+    for s, v in zip(strata, values):
+        by.setdefault(s, []).append(v)
+    for u, vals in by.items():
+        if len(vals) < 2:
+            raise ProxyError(f"unit {u!r} has {len(vals)} item(s); at least 2 are needed for a standard error")
+    return {u: np.array(vals, dtype=float) for u, vals in by.items()}
+
+
+def weighted_mean(strata, values, weights) -> float:
+    """Composite = sum_u w_u * mean of the unit's item values."""
+    return float(sum(weights[u] * g.mean() for u, g in _groups(strata, values, weights).items()))
+
+
+def analytic_se(strata, d, weights) -> float:
+    """Paired stratified SE: sqrt(sum_u w_u^2 * var_u(d) / n_u), var with ddof=1. Exact McNemar form on binary data."""
+    return float(math.sqrt(sum(weights[u] ** 2 * g.var(ddof=1) / len(g) for u, g in _groups(strata, d, weights).items())))
+
+
+def bootstrap_se(strata, d, weights, resamples: int = BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES, seed: int = 0) -> float:
+    """Stratified paired item-level bootstrap SE of the weighted diff (resample item diffs within each unit)."""
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+    groups = _groups(strata, d, weights)
+    draws = np.zeros(resamples)
+    for u in sorted(groups):  # fixed order keeps the seeded stream reproducible
+        g = groups[u]
+        idx = rng.integers(0, len(g), size=(resamples, len(g)))
+        draws += weights[u] * g[idx].mean(axis=1)
+    return float(draws.std(ddof=1))
+
+
+def compute(cand: dict, base: dict, *, weights=None, seed: int = 0, resamples: int = BOOTSTRAP_RESAMPLES, eval_ids=None) -> dict:
+    """Numbers for the di_proxy block (points, 4 decimals): score, base_score, diff, se (larger of bootstrap and analytic)."""
+    ids, strata, protocols, d = pair_items(cand, base, eval_ids)
+    w = normalised_weights(strata, weights)
+    cs = np.array([cand[i]["score"] for i in ids])
+    bs = np.array([base[i]["score"] for i in ids])
+    score = 100.0 * weighted_mean(strata, cs, w)
+    base_score = 100.0 * weighted_mean(strata, bs, w)
+    diff = 100.0 * weighted_mean(strata, d, w)
+    se = 100.0 * max(analytic_se(strata, d, w), bootstrap_se(strata, d, w, resamples, seed))
+    protos = sorted(set(protocols))
+    return {"items": len(ids), "protocol": protos[0] if len(protos) == 1 else "mixed:" + "/".join(protos),
+            "score": round(score, 4), "base_score": round(base_score, 4), "diff": round(diff, 4), "se": round(se, 4)}
+
+
+def build_block(cand, base, *, eval_id, eval_sha, base_id, weights=None, seed=0, eval_ids=None) -> dict:
+    r = compute(cand, base, weights=weights, seed=seed, eval_ids=eval_ids)
+    return {"done": True, "eval_id": eval_id, "eval_sha": eval_sha, "protocol": r["protocol"], "base_id": base_id,
+            "items": r["items"], "score": r["score"], "base_score": r["base_score"], "diff": r["diff"], "se": r["se"]}
+
+
+def _eval_item_ids(path):
+    """Ids of the frozen eval file when it is JSONL with an `id` per line; None when it has another shape."""
+    ids = []
+    try:
+        for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+            if line.strip():
+                row = json.loads(line)
+                ids.append(row["id"])
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        return None
+    return ids or None
+
+
+def main(argv=None) -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    ap.add_argument("--candidate", required=True, help="candidate per-item JSONL")
+    ap.add_argument("--base", required=True, help="base per-item JSONL")
+    ap.add_argument("--eval-file", required=True, help="frozen eval item file (sha256 is computed and checked)")
+    ap.add_argument("--eval-id", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--eval-sha", required=True, help="expected sha256 of --eval-file")
+    ap.add_argument("--base-id", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--candidate-id", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--weights", required=True,
+                    help="JSON file: unit -> weight (normalised); required so the block always uses the frozen composite")
+    ap.add_argument("--weight-field", default="unit", choices=["unit", "area", "weight_group"],
+                    help="item field the weights apply to (default unit; area is its alias)")
+    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    ap.add_argument("--min-items", type=int, default=1000, help="refuse below this many paired items (signer rule)")
+    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        sha = file_sha256(a.eval_file)
+        if sha != a.eval_sha.lower():
+            raise ProxyError(f"eval sha mismatch: file {sha} != --eval-sha {a.eval_sha}")
+        weights = json.loads(Path(a.weights).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        eval_ids = _eval_item_ids(a.eval_file)
+        if eval_ids is None:   # critic F6b: never skip the binding of the item set to the pinned eval
+            raise ProxyError("eval file is not JSONL with an id per line: the item set cannot be bound to it")
+        field = "unit" if a.weight_field == "area" else a.weight_field
+        cand = load_items(a.candidate, field)
+        base = load_items(a.base, field)
+        block = build_block(cand, base, eval_id=a.eval_id, eval_sha=sha, base_id=a.base_id, weights=weights,
+                            seed=a.seed, eval_ids=eval_ids)
+        if block["items"] < a.min_items:
+            raise ProxyError(f"only {block['items']} paired items (needs >= {a.min_items})")
+    except (ProxyError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
+        print(f"award_di_proxy: REFUSED: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    print(json.dumps(block, sort_keys=True))
+    lower90 = block["diff"] - Z90 * block["se"]
+    verdict = "meets" if lower90 >= THRESHOLD else "BELOW"
+    print(f"di_proxy {a.candidate_id} vs {a.base_id}: diff {block['diff']:+.4f} se {block['se']:.4f} "
+          f"lower90 {lower90:+.4f} ({verdict} threshold {THRESHOLD}) items {block['items']}", file=sys.stderr)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Operator tool for the engine copy line (docs/ENGINE-COMPETITION.md, "Reusing other entries (copy line)").
+
+Compares the extracted file tree of a candidate engine image with the trees of other entries and with the parents the
+candidate declares in its image label ``ai.reax.engine.parents``, and prints for each parent which files are
+byte-identical, which of those are binaries, and the verdict: "derived (declared)", "copy (undeclared)", "same owner" or
+"independent". No docker is used: extract the trees first (``docker create`` + ``docker cp <id>:/app dir``) and pass the
+directories. On a mark of "copy (undeclared)" the operator creates ``<review_dir>/COPY/<child digest>`` by hand.
+
+  engine_parents_check.py CHILD_DIR --parent DIGEST=DIR [--parent ...] [--declared LABEL_JSON_OR_FILE]
+        [--same-owner DIGEST ...] [--ignore-tree DIR ...] [--json]
+
+``--ignore-tree``: trees whose files are never counted (the reference image, a common base): shared boilerplate is not reuse.
+``--same-owner``: parent digests held by the same coldkey (snapshot) or proven by a signed ownership proof.
+Pass EVERY digest of the parent's hotkey as --parent (the validator's bar is the best score over all of them, and the same
+files may sit in an older digest). A declared digest without a --parent tree cannot be verified: verdict "unverified
+declaration", exit 3. A file entry of the label that ends in "/" is a directory prefix. Closed components (binary code without
+source, weights excluded) are reported: withhold the award approval while any is present. Detected reuse that the label
+does not declare is a copy (create COPY/<child digest>; COPY alone is enough, REVIEWED is not needed).
+Exit code: 0 independent / derived / same owner, 2 copy (undeclared), 3 declared digest not verifiable, 1 usage error.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Mapping, Optional
+
+from reax_subnet import engcopyline
+
+MIN_SHARED_BYTES = 1  # an empty file (e.g. __init__.py) is no evidence of reuse
+
+
+def tree_hashes(root: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """``{"/relative/path": sha256}`` of every regular, non-empty file under ``root`` (symlinks are not followed)."""
+    out: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
+        dirnames.sort()
+        for name in sorted(filenames):
+            path = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
+            if os.path.islink(path) or not os.path.isfile(path) or os.path.getsize(path) < MIN_SHARED_BYTES:
+                continue
+            h = hashlib.sha256()
+            with open(path, "rb") as fh:
+                for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
+                    h.update(chunk)
+            out["/" + os.path.relpath(path, root).replace(os.sep, "/")] = h.hexdigest()
+    return out
+
+
+def shared_files(child: Mapping[str, str], other: Mapping[str, str], ignore_hashes: set[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Child paths whose content is byte-identical with any file of ``other`` (any path: a rename is still reuse)."""
+    theirs = set(other.values()) - ignore_hashes
+    return sorted(p for p, h in child.items() if h in theirs)
+
+
+def check(child: Mapping[str, str], parents: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]], declared_label: Optional[str],
+          same_owner: set[str], ignore: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict:
+    """The report (a dict, JSON-serialisable). Pure on the hash maps."""
+    declared, problems = engcopyline.parse_parents(declared_label)
+    ignore_hashes = set(ignore.values())
+    shared = {d: shared_files(child, tree, ignore_hashes) for d, tree in parents.items()}
+    declared_files = {p.digest: p.files for p in declared}
+    unmatched = sorted(d for d in declared_files if d not in parents)  # declared, but no tree was given for it
+    overall, per = engcopyline.verdict([p.digest for p in declared], shared, same_owner, declared_files)
+    if unmatched and overall != engcopyline.VERDICT_COPY:
+        overall = "unverified declaration"
+    return {
+        "verdict": overall,
+        "parents": {d: {"verdict": per.get(d, engcopyline.VERDICT_INDEPENDENT), "shared_files": shared.get(d, []),
+                        "shared_binaries": [f for f in shared.get(d, []) if engcopyline.is_binary_name(f)],
+                        "declared": d in declared_files, "same_owner": d in same_owner,
+                        "undeclared_files": [f for f in shared.get(d, []) if not engcopyline.file_declared(f, declared_files.get(d, ()))]}
+                    for d in sorted(set(parents) | set(declared_files))},
+        "must_beat": engcopyline.constraint_parents((p.digest for p in declared), (), same_owner),
+        "closed_components": engcopyline.closed_components(child),  # withhold the award approval while any is present
+        "unverified_declared": unmatched,
+        "label_problems": problems,
+    }
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
+    ap.add_argument("child", help="extracted file tree of the candidate image")
+    ap.add_argument("--parent", action="append", default=[], metavar="DIGEST=DIR")
+    ap.add_argument("--declared", default=None, help="the parents label value (JSON) or a file holding it")
+    ap.add_argument("--same-owner", action="append", default=[], metavar="DIGEST")
+    ap.add_argument("--ignore-tree", action="append", default=[], metavar="DIR")
+    ap.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
+    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    declared = a.declared
+    if declared and os.path.isfile(declared):
+        with open(declared, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            declared = fh.read()
+    parents = {}
+    for item in a.parent:
+        digest, sep, d = item.partition("=")
+        if not sep or not os.path.isdir(d):
+            print(f"bad --parent {item!r} (DIGEST=DIR, DIR must exist)", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+        parents[digest] = tree_hashes(d)
+    if not os.path.isdir(a.child):
+        print("child directory does not exist", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    ignore: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for d in a.ignore_tree:
+        ignore.update(tree_hashes(d))
+    child = tree_hashes(a.child)
+    report = check(child, parents, declared, set(a.same_owner), ignore)
+    if a.json:
+        print(json.dumps(report, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
+    else:
+        print("verdict:", report["verdict"])
+        for d, r in report["parents"].items():
+            print(f"  parent {d[:12]}: {r['verdict']}; {len(r['shared_files'])} identical file(s), "
+                  f"{len(r['shared_binaries'])} binary; declared={r['declared']} same_owner={r['same_owner']}")
+            for f in r["undeclared_files"]:
+                print("    undeclared:", f)
+        if report["must_beat"]:
+            print("must beat by the full margin:", ", ".join(x[:12] for x in report["must_beat"]))
+        if report["closed_components"]:
+            print("closed components (WITHHOLD the award approval until their source is published):",
+                  ", ".join(c + (" (weights? (check))" if engcopyline.needs_weights_check(c) else "")
+                            for c in report["closed_components"]))
+        for d in report["unverified_declared"]:
+            print(f"declared parent {d[:12]} has no --parent tree: cannot verify (pass every digest of that hotkey)")
+        for p in report["label_problems"]:
+            print("label problem:", p)
+    if report["verdict"] == engcopyline.VERDICT_COPY:
+        return 2
+    return 3 if report["unverified_declared"] else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

@@ -0,0 +1,371 @@
+"""Simulate per-coldkey diminishing returns (tiers.COLDKEY_DR_*) on the public dashboard data.
+
+    python tools/sim_coldkey_dr.py latest.json --out-dir DIR     # writes DIR/sim.json and DIR/SIM.md
+
+Rebuilds ema_by_pool / capacity_by_pool from the dashboard's per-miner rows (uid, pool, ema, capacity.dps), runs today's
+``compute_tiered_weights`` and the variants, and prints before/after distributions. Read-only on the input.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import statistics
+import sys
+from collections import defaultdict
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))
+from reax_subnet import tiers  # noqa: E402
+
+POOLS = ("s1-fast", "s1-pro", "s1-lite", "s1-cpu")
+MIN_EMA = 0.3  # ScoringParams.min_ema
+T0 = datetime(2030, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+DEFAULT_POOLS = ("s1-lite", "s1-cpu")  # tiers.COLDKEY_DR_POOLS default (headline variant); POOLS = the "all pools" alternative
+BUCKETS = (("1", 1, 1), ("2", 2, 2), ("3-5", 3, 5), ("6-10", 6, 10), (">10", 11, 10**9))
+
+
+def load(path):
+    d = json.load(open(path))
+    ema = {p: {} for p in POOLS}
+    cap = {p: {} for p in POOLS}
+    coldkey, hotkey, published = {}, {}, {}
+    for m in d["miners"]:
+        coldkey[m["uid"]], hotkey[m["uid"]] = m["coldkey"], m["hotkey"]
+        published[m["uid"]] = m.get("weight") or 0.0
+        pools = ([m["pool"]] if m["pool"] else []) + list(m.get("also_pools") or [])
+        for p in pools:
+            if p in ema and m.get("ema") is not None:
+                ema[p][m["uid"]] = m["ema"]
+                if m.get("capacity"):
+                    cap[p][m["uid"]] = m["capacity"]["dps"]
+    return d, ema, cap, coldkey, hotkey, published
+
+
+def run(ema, cap, coldkey, *, dr, free=2, ratio=0.7, dr_pools=DEFAULT_POOLS, brake=0.5, coldkey_override=None):
+    """Weights per uid. dr=False is today's rule; dr_pools is tiers.COLDKEY_DR_POOLS (the other pools pay as today)."""
+    saved = (tiers.COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC, tiers.COLDKEY_FREE_SLOTS, tiers.COLDKEY_DR_RATIO, tiers.COLDKEY_DR_POOLS)
+    tiers.COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC, tiers.COLDKEY_FREE_SLOTS, tiers.COLDKEY_DR_RATIO = T0, free, ratio
+    tiers.COLDKEY_DR_POOLS = frozenset(dr_pools)
+    try:
+        cmap = coldkey_override or coldkey
+        return tiers.compute_tiered_weights(ema, cap, tiers.TierBudgets(order_ratio=brake), None, MIN_EMA,
+                                            coldkey_of=cmap if dr else None, now=T0 if dr else None)
+    finally:
+        tiers.COLDKEY_DR_START_UTC, tiers.COLDKEY_FREE_SLOTS, tiers.COLDKEY_DR_RATIO, tiers.COLDKEY_DR_POOLS = saved
+
+
+def gini(xs):
+    xs = sorted(x for x in xs)
+    n, s = len(xs), sum(xs)
+    return 0.0 if n == 0 or s == 0 else sum((2 * i - n + 1) * x for i, x in enumerate(xs)) / (n * s)
+
+
+def corr(a, b):
+    ma, mb = statistics.fmean(a), statistics.fmean(b)
+    va = math.sqrt(sum((x - ma) ** 2 for x in a))
+    vb = math.sqrt(sum((x - mb) ** 2 for x in b))
+    return sum((x - ma) * (y - mb) for x, y in zip(a, b)) / (va * vb) if va and vb else float("nan")
+
+
+def bucket(n):
+    return next(b for b, lo, hi in BUCKETS if lo <= n <= hi)
+
+
+def summarize(w, coldkey, uids_by_ck):
+    per_ck = defaultdict(float)
+    for u, x in w.items():
+        per_ck[coldkey[u]] += x
+    top5 = sorted(per_ck.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:5]
+    return {"gini_hotkeys": gini(list(w.values())), "gini_coldkeys": gini(list(per_ck.values())),
+            "top5_coldkeys": [(c[:8], round(x, 5)) for c, x in top5], "top5_share": round(sum(x for _, x in top5), 5)}
+
+
+def per_tier(w, ema):
+    out = {}
+    for t in tiers.TIER_ORDER:
+        us = {u for p in POOLS if tiers.POOL_TIER[p] == t for u in ema[p]}
+        out[t] = round(sum(w.get(u, 0.0) for u in us), 5)
+    return out
+
+
+def per_pool_ck(w, ema, coldkey):
+    out = {}
+    for p in POOLS:
+        d = defaultdict(float)
+        for u in ema[p]:
+            d[coldkey[u]] += w.get(u, 0.0)
+        out[p] = {"total": round(sum(d.values()), 5), "gini_coldkeys": round(gini(list(d.values())), 4),
+                  "top5": [(c[:8], round(x, 5)) for c, x in sorted(d.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:5]]}
+    return out
+
+
+def compare_variant(base, new, coldkey, ema):
+    """Per-coldkey change new/base-1 for paid coldkeys; buckets by hotkeys with weight in the base run."""
+    n_hk = defaultdict(int)
+    tot_b, tot_n = defaultdict(float), defaultdict(float)
+    for u, x in base.items():
+        n_hk[coldkey[u]] += 1
+        tot_b[coldkey[u]] += x
+    for u, x in new.items():
+        tot_n[coldkey[u]] += x
+    rows = {}
+    for b, lo, hi in BUCKETS:
+        cks = [c for c, n in n_hk.items() if lo <= n <= hi]
+        if not cks:
+            continue
+        ch = [tot_n[c] / tot_b[c] - 1 for c in cks if tot_b[c] > 0]
+        per_hk_b = [base[u] for u in base if coldkey[u] in cks]
+        per_hk_n = [new.get(u, 0.0) for u in base if coldkey[u] in cks]
+        rows[b] = {"coldkeys": len(cks), "hotkeys": len(per_hk_b), "median_hotkey_before": statistics.median(per_hk_b),
+                   "median_hotkey_after": statistics.median(per_hk_n),
+                   "coldkey_change_min": min(ch), "coldkey_change_median": statistics.median(ch), "coldkey_change_max": max(ch),
+                   "within_5pct": sum(abs(x) <= 0.05 for x in ch), "within_10pct": sum(abs(x) <= 0.10 for x in ch), "n": len(ch)}
+    small = [c for c, n in n_hk.items() if n <= 2 and tot_b[c] > 0]
+    ch = [tot_n[c] / tot_b[c] - 1 for c in small]
+    return rows, {"small_coldkeys": len(small), "min": min(ch), "max": max(ch), "within_5pct": sum(abs(x) <= 0.05 for x in ch),
+                  "within_10pct": sum(abs(x) <= 0.10 for x in ch)}
+
+
+def uplift(base, new, coldkey, ema):
+    """Per pool: factor w'/w of the miners DR does not touch (single hotkey of a coldkey in the pool; the pool's freed
+    weight and the tier-cap change reach them all alike). The honest reference for 'unchanged'."""
+    out = {}
+    for p in POOLS:
+        cnt = defaultdict(int)
+        for u in ema[p]:
+            cnt[coldkey[u]] += 1
+        xs = [new.get(u, 0.0) / base[u] for u in ema[p] if u in base and cnt[coldkey[u]] == 1]
+        out[p] = statistics.median(xs) if xs else float("nan")
+    return out
+
+
+def relative_small(base, new, coldkey, ema):
+    """Coldkeys with <= 2 paid hotkeys: pay change relative to the untouched miners of their pool (0 = DR does nothing)."""
+    up = uplift(base, new, coldkey, ema)
+    pool_of = {u: p for p in POOLS for u in ema[p]}
+    n_hk = defaultdict(int)
+    for u in base:
+        n_hk[coldkey[u]] += 1
+    rel = {}
+    for c, n in n_hk.items():
+        if n > 2:
+            continue
+        us = [u for u in base if coldkey[u] == c]
+        exp = sum(base[u] * up[pool_of[u]] for u in us)
+        rel[c] = sum(new.get(u, 0.0) for u in us) / exp - 1
+    return rel
+
+
+def relative_buckets(base, new, coldkey, ema):
+    """Per hotkey-count bucket: coldkey pay change relative to the uplift of the untouched miners of its pools."""
+    up = uplift(base, new, coldkey, ema)
+    pool_of = {u: p for p in POOLS for u in ema[p]}
+    n_hk, exp, tot = defaultdict(int), defaultdict(float), defaultdict(float)
+    for u, x in base.items():
+        n_hk[coldkey[u]] += 1
+        exp[coldkey[u]] += x * up[pool_of[u]]
+        tot[coldkey[u]] += new.get(u, 0.0)
+    out = {}
+    for b, lo, hi in BUCKETS:
+        ch = [tot[c] / exp[c] - 1 for c, n in n_hk.items() if lo <= n <= hi and exp[c] > 0]
+        if ch:
+            out[b] = {"rel_min": min(ch), "rel_median": statistics.median(ch), "rel_max": max(ch)}
+    return out
+
+
+def notice_table(base, new, coldkey, ema, lite_farm):
+    """Per pool: raw pay change of a miner that is its coldkey's only hotkey in the pool (median), and the raw change of
+    the s1-lite farm coldkey (whole coldkey total)."""
+    out = {}
+    for p in POOLS:
+        cnt = defaultdict(int)
+        for u in ema[p]:
+            cnt[coldkey[u]] += 1
+        xs = [new.get(u, 0.0) / base[u] - 1 for u in ema[p] if u in base and cnt[coldkey[u]] == 1]
+        out[p] = {"single_hotkey_median": statistics.median(xs) if xs else None, "single_hotkey_min": min(xs) if xs else None,
+                  "single_hotkey_max": max(xs) if xs else None, "n": len(xs)}
+    us = [u for u in base if coldkey[u] == lite_farm]
+    out["lite_farm"] = {"hotkeys": len(us), "change": sum(new.get(u, 0.0) for u in us) / sum(base[u] for u in us) - 1}
+    return out
+
+
+def farm_stats(w, coldkey, ck):
+    us = [u for u in w if coldkey[u] == ck]
+    xs = sorted((w[u] for u in us), reverse=True)
+    return {"hotkeys": len(xs), "total": sum(xs), "per_hotkey_mean": sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else 0.0,
+            "first": xs[0] if xs else 0.0, "last": xs[-1] if xs else 0.0}
+
+
+def evasion(ema, cap, coldkey, farm, n_list, **kw):
+    """The farm spreads its hotkeys round-robin over n coldkeys it controls."""
+    us = sorted(u for u in coldkey if coldkey[u] == farm)
+    out = {}
+    for n in n_list:
+        ov = dict(coldkey)
+        for i, u in enumerate(us):
+            ov[u] = f"{farm}#{i % n}"
+        w = run(ema, cap, coldkey, dr=True, coldkey_override=ov, **kw)
+        out[n] = sum(w.get(u, 0.0) for u in us)
+    return out
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("data")
+    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", required=True)
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    d, ema, cap, coldkey, hotkey, published = load(a.data)
+    out = {"source": a.data, "generated_at": d["generated_at"]}
+
+    base = run(ema, cap, coldkey, dr=False)
+    out["baseline"] = {"miners_paid": len(base), "sum": sum(base.values()), "per_tier": per_tier(base, ema),
+                       "per_pool": per_pool_ck(base, ema, coldkey), **summarize(base, coldkey, None)}
+
+    # 1. against the published weights (inference part only)
+    pooled = sorted(base)
+    pub_in = {u: published[u] for u in pooled}
+    s_pub = sum(pub_in.values())
+    pub_norm = [pub_in[u] / s_pub for u in pooled]
+    sim_v = [base[u] for u in pooled]
+    diffs = [abs(p - s) for p, s in zip(pub_norm, sim_v)]
+    worst = sorted(zip(diffs, pooled), reverse=True)[:5]
+    out["vs_published"] = {"miners_compared": len(pooled), "published_sum_over_pooled": s_pub,
+                           "published_sum_all": sum(published.values()),
+                           "correlation_normalised": corr(pub_norm, sim_v),
+                           "max_abs_diff_normalised": max(diffs), "mean_abs_diff": statistics.fmean(diffs),
+                           "max_abs_diff_raw": max(abs(published[u] - base[u]) for u in pooled),
+                           "worst": [(u, hotkey[u][:6], round(published[u] / s_pub, 5), round(base[u], 5)) for _, u in worst]}
+
+    # 2. before/after: headline = default pools (s1-lite, s1-cpu), alternative = all four pools; free 2, ratio 0.7
+    n_by = defaultdict(int)
+    for u in base:
+        n_by[coldkey[u]] += 1
+    farms = [c for c, n in n_by.items() if n > 10]
+    lite_farm = max((c for c in farms if any(c == coldkey[u] for u in ema["s1-lite"])), key=lambda c: n_by[c])
+    out["farm_pools"] = {c[:8]: sorted({p for p in POOLS for u in ema[p] if coldkey[u] == c}) for c in farms}
+    for key, pools in (("default", DEFAULT_POOLS), ("all_pools", POOLS)):
+        after = run(ema, cap, coldkey, dr=True, dr_pools=pools)
+        blk = {"free": 2, "ratio": 0.7, "pools": list(pools), "per_tier": per_tier(after, ema),
+               "per_pool": per_pool_ck(after, ema, coldkey), **summarize(after, coldkey, None)}
+        rows, small = compare_variant(base, after, coldkey, ema)
+        rel = relative_buckets(base, after, coldkey, ema)
+        for k in rows:
+            rows[k].update(rel.get(k, {}))
+        blk["buckets"], blk["small"] = rows, small
+        blk["uplift"] = {k: round(x, 3) for k, x in uplift(base, after, coldkey, ema).items()}
+        blk["notice"] = notice_table(base, after, coldkey, ema, lite_farm)
+        blk["farms"] = {c[:8]: {"before": farm_stats(base, coldkey, c), "after": farm_stats(after, coldkey, c)} for c in farms}
+        blk["evasion"] = {c[:8]: {"hotkeys": n_by[c], "base": sum(base[u] for u in base if coldkey[u] == c),
+                                  "by_coldkeys": evasion(ema, cap, coldkey, c, sorted({1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 13, n_by[c]}), dr_pools=pools)}
+                          for c in farms}
+        out[key] = blk
+    out["lite_farm"] = lite_farm[:8]
+
+    # 3. variants
+    var = []
+    for free in (1, 2, 3):
+        for ratio in (0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8):
+            for scope, dp in (("lite+cpu only (default)", DEFAULT_POOLS), ("all pools", POOLS)):
+                w = run(ema, cap, coldkey, dr=True, free=free, ratio=ratio, dr_pools=dp)
+                _, sm = compare_variant(base, w, coldkey, ema)
+                big = {c[:8]: sum(w.get(u, 0.0) for u in w if coldkey[u] == c) / max(1e-12, sum(base[u] for u in base if coldkey[u] == c)) - 1
+                       for c in farms}
+                rel = list(relative_small(base, w, coldkey, ema).values())
+                var.append({"rel_min": min(rel), "rel_max": max(rel), "rel_within_5": sum(abs(x) <= 0.05 for x in rel),
+                            "uplift": {k: round(x, 3) for k, x in uplift(base, w, coldkey, ema).items()},
+                            "eff_limit": free + ratio / (1 - ratio), "free": free, "ratio": ratio, "scope": scope, "small_min": sm["min"], "small_max": sm["max"],
+                            "small_within_5": sm["within_5pct"], "small_n": sm["small_coldkeys"],
+                            "small_within_10": sm["within_10pct"], "farm_change": big, "gini_hotkeys": gini(list(w.values()))})
+    out["variants"] = var
+    # brake-only reference: no DR but order_ratio 1.0 (isolates what the removed brake alone does)
+    nobrake = run(ema, cap, coldkey, dr=False, brake=1.0)
+    _, sm = compare_variant(base, nobrake, coldkey, ema)
+    out["no_brake_no_dr"] = {"per_tier": per_tier(nobrake, ema), "small": sm,
+                             "farm_change": {c[:8]: sum(nobrake.get(u, 0) for u in nobrake if coldkey[u] == c)
+                                             / sum(base[u] for u in base if coldkey[u] == c) - 1 for c in farms}}
+
+    out["_variant_note"] = "farm_change = farm total share after / before - 1"
+
+    od = Path(a.out_dir)
+    od.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (od / "sim.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=float))
+    (od / "SIM.md").write_text(render(out))
+    print(render(out))
+
+
+def pct(x):
+    return f"{x * 100:+.1f}%"
+
+
+def render(o):
+    L = [f"# Per-coldkey diminishing returns: simulation on {o['generated_at']} dashboard data", "",
+         "Generated by `tools/sim_coldkey_dr.py` (inference part only: owner/burn 0, competition layer left out, min_ema 0.3).", ""]
+    b, v = o["baseline"], o["vs_published"]
+    L += ["## 1. Today's rule against the published weights", "",
+          f"Baseline `compute_tiered_weights` (TierBudgets defaults, order_ratio 0.5) pays {b['miners_paid']} miners. Per tier: {b['per_tier']}.",
+          f"Published `weight` summed over those miners: {v['published_sum_over_pooled']:.4f} (all rows: {v['published_sum_all']:.4f}; the rest goes to the",
+          "competition layer / owner rows). Compared after normalising the published weights of the pooled miners to sum 1:", "",
+          f"* correlation {v['correlation_normalised']:.4f}, max abs diff {v['max_abs_diff_normalised']:.5f}, mean abs diff {v['mean_abs_diff']:.5f}",
+          f"* worst: {v['worst']} (uid, hotkey, published normalised, simulated)", "",
+          "The gap is expected: the published weight is the validator's final vector (inference part scaled down by the competition",
+          "layer, plus keep-alive shares), emitted at 09:04Z from the EMA/capacity state of that moment, while the dashboard rows are 10:12Z;",
+          "dashboard `ema` and `capacity.dps` are rounded, and uids that moved between pools in between differ. Not forced to match.", ""]
+    L += ["## 2. Before / after", "",
+          "Headline: **default** = DR in s1-lite and s1-cpu only (`COLDKEY_DR_POOLS`), 2 free slots, ratio 0.7, brake 0.5 -> 1.0. "
+          "Alternative: **all pools** (the same constants, all four pools). *raw* = change of the coldkey's total share vs today; "
+          "*rel.* = change relative to the uplift of the untouched miners of the same pools (0 = the rule does nothing to the coldkey).", "",
+          f"Baseline Gini over hotkeys {b['gini_hotkeys']:.4f}, over coldkeys {b['gini_coldkeys']:.4f}; top-5 coldkeys hold {b['top5_share']:.4f}: {b['top5_coldkeys']}",
+          f"Baseline tier totals {b['per_tier']}", ""]
+    for key, title in (("default", "2a. Default (s1-lite, s1-cpu)"), ("all_pools", "2b. Alternative: all pools")):
+        v = o[key]
+        L += [f"### {title}", "",
+              f"After: Gini hotkeys {v['gini_hotkeys']:.4f}, coldkeys {v['gini_coldkeys']:.4f}; top-5 hold {v['top5_share']:.4f}: {v['top5_coldkeys']}",
+              f"Tier totals before {b['per_tier']} after {v['per_tier']}; uplift of untouched single-hotkey miners fast/pro/lite/cpu: "
+              f"{'/'.join(f'{x:.2f}' for x in v['uplift'].values())}", "", "Per pool (total, Gini over coldkeys, top-5 coldkeys), before -> after:", ""]
+        for p in b["per_pool"]:
+            x, y = b["per_pool"][p], v["per_pool"][p]
+            L.append(f"* {p}: {x['total']} / {x['gini_coldkeys']} / {x['top5']}  ->  {y['total']} / {y['gini_coldkeys']} / {y['top5']}")
+        L += ["", "By hotkeys per coldkey (paid hotkeys; change of the coldkey's total share, raw and relative):", "",
+              "| hotkeys | coldkeys | hotkeys | median/hotkey before | after | raw min / median / max | rel. min / median / max | within 5 % | within 10 % |",
+              "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+        for k, r in v["buckets"].items():
+            L.append(f"| {k} | {r['coldkeys']} | {r['hotkeys']} | {r['median_hotkey_before']:.5f} | {r['median_hotkey_after']:.5f} | "
+                     f"{pct(r['coldkey_change_min'])} / {pct(r['coldkey_change_median'])} / {pct(r['coldkey_change_max'])} | "
+                     f"{pct(r['rel_min'])} / {pct(r['rel_median'])} / {pct(r['rel_max'])} | {r['within_5pct']}/{r['n']} | {r['within_10pct']}/{r['n']} |")
+        L += ["", "The four big coldkeys (more than 10 paid hotkeys):", "",
+              "| coldkey | pools | hotkeys | total before | after | change | mean/hotkey before | after | last/first hotkey before | after |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
+        for c, f in v["farms"].items():
+            bb, aa = f["before"], f["after"]
+            L.append(f"| {c}.. | {','.join(o['farm_pools'][c])} | {bb['hotkeys']} | {bb['total']:.5f} | {aa['total']:.5f} | {pct(aa['total'] / bb['total'] - 1)} | "
+                     f"{bb['per_hotkey_mean']:.5f} | {aa['per_hotkey_mean']:.5f} | {bb['last'] / bb['first']:.2f} | {aa['last'] / aa['first']:.2f} |")
+        L += ["", "Evasion: the coldkey spreads its hotkeys over N coldkeys it controls (total share of its hotkeys; `base` is today's):", ""]
+        for c, e in v["evasion"].items():
+            L.append(f"* {c}.. ({e['hotkeys']} hotkeys, today {e['base']:.5f}): " + ", ".join(f"N={n}: {x:.5f} ({pct(x / e['base'] - 1)})" for n, x in e["by_coldkeys"].items()))
+        L.append("")
+    L += ["### 2c. Table for the public notice (default variant, whole percent)", "",
+          f"`single-hotkey miner` = median raw pay change of a miner that is its coldkey's only hotkey in the pool (includes the weight the rule frees "
+          f"and the lifted brake). `{o['lite_farm']}..` = the {o['default']['notice']['lite_farm']['hotkeys']}-hotkey s1-lite coldkey, raw change of its total.", "",
+          "| pool | single-hotkey miner pay change (raw) | 26-hotkey s1-lite coldkey change (raw) |", "|---|---|---|"]
+    for p in POOLS:
+        med = o["default"]["notice"][p]["single_hotkey_median"]
+        farm = f"{o['default']['notice']['lite_farm']['change'] * 100:+.0f}%" if p == "s1-lite" else "n/a"
+        L.append(f"| {p} | {'n/a' if med is None else f'{med * 100:+.0f}%'} | {farm} |")
+    L.append("")
+    nb = o["no_brake_no_dr"]
+    L += ["", f"Reference: removing only the brake (order_ratio 1.0, no DR) moves the tiers to {nb['per_tier']}; coldkeys with <= 2 hotkeys change "
+          f"{pct(nb['small']['min'])} .. {pct(nb['small']['max'])} ({nb['small']['within_5pct']}/{nb['small']['small_coldkeys']} within 5 %); farms {({k: pct(x) for k, x in nb['farm_change'].items()})}.", ""]
+    L += ["## 3. Variants", "", "`small` = coldkeys with <= 2 paid hotkeys. *raw* = change of the coldkey's total share vs today (includes the redistribution of the farms' freed weight, which lifts every untouched miner of a pool by the same *uplift* factor). *rel.* = change relative to that uplift (0 = the rule does nothing to the coldkey; this is the 'honest operator unchanged' test). farm = total share change.", "",
+          "| free | ratio | scope | max effective hotkeys per coldkey | uplift of untouched miners fast/pro/lite/cpu | small rel. min | small rel. max | rel. within 5 % | small raw min | small raw max | raw within 5 % | " + " | ".join(f"farm {k}" for k in o["farm_pools"]) + " | Gini hotkeys |", "|" + "---|" * (11 + len(o["farm_pools"]) + 1)]
+    for r in o["variants"]:
+        L.append(f"| {r['free']} | {r['ratio']} | {r['scope']} | {r['eff_limit']:.2f} | {'/'.join(f'{x:.2f}' for x in r['uplift'].values())} | "
+                 f"{pct(r['rel_min'])} | {pct(r['rel_max'])} | {r['rel_within_5']}/{r['small_n']} | {pct(r['small_min'])} | {pct(r['small_max'])} | {r['small_within_5']}/{r['small_n']} | "
+                 + " | ".join(pct(x) for x in r["farm_change"].values()) + f" | {r['gini_hotkeys']:.4f} |")
+    L += ["", "Honest limit: DR can only see a coldkey link on chain. A farm that registers hotkeys under N different coldkeys keeps",
+          "two free slots per coldkey, so the rule raises its cost (one more coldkey per two hotkeys) but does not remove the incentive.", ""]
+    return "\n".join(L)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
