@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+"""`vali_synthetic_monitor --tier per-miner`: off pushes nothing; on, a
+probe that reached its miner pushes the per-miner run group, and every
+run pushes the fleet readout — under names the full tier's alerts never
+match."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+from django.core.management import call_command
+
+from apps.scheduler.tests.factories import node_id
+from apps.synthetic import e2e, per_miner
+from apps.synthetic import metrics as metrics_mod
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.django_db
+
+AT = datetime(2026, 10, 21, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def pushed(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_push(ms: metrics_mod.MetricSet, **kw: Any) -> bool:
+        out.append(
+            {"grouping_key": kw["grouping_key"], "replace": kw["replace"], "text": ms.render()}
+        )
+        return True
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(metrics_mod, "push", fake_push)
+    return out
+
+
+def _view(seed: int, *, blocked: str = "", probed: datetime | None = None) -> per_miner.MinerView:
+    return per_miner.MinerView(
+        node_id=node_id(seed),
+        miner_id=f"miner-{seed:02d}",
+        platform_id="ab" * 16,
+        blocked=blocked,
+        last_attempt_at=probed,
+        last_probe_at=probed,
+    )
+
+
+def _report(verdict: str, *, success: bool, stage: str = "boot") -> per_miner.TickReport:
+    view = _view(1)
+    stages = [e2e.StageResult("launch", True, 1.0, "ok")]
+    if not success:
+        stages.append(e2e.StageResult(stage, False, 2.0, "boom"))
+    outcome = e2e.E2EOutcome("ubuntu", "synmon-pm-x-1", success=success, stages=stages)
+    return per_miner.TickReport(
+        enabled=True,
+        universe=2,
+        claim=per_miner.Claim(view=view, vm_id="synmon-pm-x-1"),
+        outcome=outcome,
+        verdict=verdict,
+    )
+
+
+def _fleet(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    rows = [
+        per_miner.FleetRow(view=_view(1, probed=AT), fail_streak=2, last_ok=False),
+        per_miner.FleetRow(view=_view(2, blocked="capacity"), fail_streak=0, last_ok=None),
+    ]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(per_miner, "fleet_readout", lambda now: rows)
+
+
+def test_off_pushes_nothing(settings: Any, pushed: list, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_PER_MINER = False
+    monkeypatch.setattr(per_miner, "tick", lambda **k: pytest.fail("ran while off"))
+    call_command("vali_synthetic_monitor", "--tier", "per-miner")
+    assert pushed == []
+
+
+def test_a_failed_probe_pushes_the_miner_group_and_the_fleet(
+    settings: Any, pushed: list, monkeypatch, capsys
+) -> None:
+    settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_PER_MINER = True
+    settings.VALI_GUEST_ATTEST_RESOURCES = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        per_miner, "tick", lambda **k: _report(per_miner.VERDICT_FAILED, success=False)
+    )
+    _fleet(monkeypatch)
+    call_command("vali_synthetic_monitor", "--tier", "per-miner", "--json")
+
+    run, fleet = pushed
+    assert run["grouping_key"] == {"tier": "per-miner", "miner": "miner-01"}
+    assert run["replace"] is False  # failure → POST, the last-success ts survives
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_success 0" in run["text"]
+    assert 'hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_stage_success{stage="boot"} 0' in run["text"]
+    assert 'hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_stage_success{stage="launch"} 1' in run["text"]
+    assert 'stage="resources"' in run["text"]  # checked ⇒ reported
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_last_success_timestamp" not in run["text"]
+    # Never the full tier's names: its critical alerts key on them.
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_e2e_success" not in run["text"]
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_last_success_timestamp" not in run["text"]
+
+    assert fleet["grouping_key"] == {"tier": "per-miner-fleet"}
+    assert fleet["replace"] is True
+    text = fleet["text"]
+    ts = int(AT.timestamp())
+    assert f'hippius_synthetic_miner_last_probe_timestamp{{miner="miner-01"}} {ts}' in text
+    assert 'hippius_synthetic_miner_last_probe_timestamp{miner="miner-02"} 0' in text
+    assert 'hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_fail_streak{miner="miner-01"} 2' in text
+    assert 'hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_blocked{miner="miner-02",reason="capacity"} 1' in text
+    assert 'miner="miner-01",reason=' not in text
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_per_miner_universe 2" in text
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_per_miner_config_error 0" in text
+
+    payload = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
+    assert payload["verdict"] == "failed" and payload["miner_id"] == "miner-01"
+
+
+def test_a_pass_replaces_the_miner_group(settings: Any, pushed: list, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_PER_MINER = True
+    settings.VALI_GUEST_ATTEST_RESOURCES = False
+    monkeypatch.setattr(per_miner, "tick", lambda **k: _report(per_miner.VERDICT_OK, success=True))
+    _fleet(monkeypatch)
+    call_command("vali_synthetic_monitor", "--tier", "per-miner")
+    run = pushed[0]
+    assert run["replace"] is True
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_success 1" in run["text"]
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_miner_probe_last_success_timestamp" in run["text"]
+    assert 'stage="resources"' not in run["text"]  # not checked ⇒ not reported as 0
+
+
+def test_an_inconclusive_probe_touches_no_miner_series(
+    settings: Any, pushed: list, monkeypatch
+) -> None:
+    settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_PER_MINER = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        per_miner,
+        "tick",
+        lambda **k: _report(per_miner.VERDICT_INCONCLUSIVE, success=False, stage="launch_complete"),
+    )
+    _fleet(monkeypatch)
+    call_command("vali_synthetic_monitor", "--tier", "per-miner")
+    assert [p["grouping_key"] for p in pushed] == [{"tier": "per-miner-fleet"}]
+
+
+def test_a_misconfiguration_is_alertable(settings: Any, pushed: list, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_PER_MINER = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        per_miner, "tick", lambda **k: per_miner.TickReport(enabled=True, error="no token")
+    )
+    _fleet(monkeypatch)
+    call_command("vali_synthetic_monitor", "--tier", "per-miner")
+    assert "hippius_synthetic_per_miner_config_error 1" in pushed[0]["text"]

+"""Per-miner probe — the pinned launch, the `resources` stage, and the
+evidence a probe leaves: a failed start counts like a tenant's, the VM
+never bills, and its shortfall corroborates as ONE tenant. (`last_probe`
+on `/v1/operator/nodes` is pinned in `apps/operator/tests/test_nodes.py`.)
+
+The launch-path claims drive the REAL `launch_on_miner` (collaborators
+stubbed by `test_launch_service`) with the probe's own identity, so a
+future "skip the synthetic tenant" anywhere in that path fails here.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import itertools
+from datetime import timedelta
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+from django.conf import settings
+from django.test import override_settings
+from django.utils import timezone
+
+from apps.lifecycle.models import Vm
+from apps.orchestration.services import launch
+from apps.scheduler import capacity_earn, scoring
+from apps.scheduler.capacity_admin import STRIKE_FIELD
+from apps.scheduler.models import (
+    CapacityTrustClass,
+    MinerCapacity,
+    MinerCapacityAudit,
+    PlacementStatus,
+)
+from apps.scheduler.tests.factories import (
+    make_placement,
+    make_vm,
+    node_id,
+)
+from apps.synthetic import e2e
+from apps.telemetry.models import GuestResourceShortfall, VmLiveAttestation
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.django_db
+
+PROBE_VM = "synmon-pm-000000000000-1792500000"
+_SEQ = itertools.count(1)
+
+
+# ─── the pinned launch body ──────────────────────────────────────────
+
+
+def test_the_probe_launch_is_pinned_and_attributable(blessed_ubuntu) -> None:
+    body = e2e.build_launch_body("ubuntu", PROBE_VM, platform_id="ab" * 32, flavor="small")
+    assert body["platform_id"] == "ab" * 32
+    assert body["flavor"] == "small"
+    assert body["vm_id"] == PROBE_VM
+    # Owner = the synthetic tenant: what `Placement.owner` records, what
+    # the reward/billing exclusion and the reaper key on.
+    assert body["tenant_id"] == body["user_id"] == settings.VALI_SYNTHETIC_TENANT_ID
+    # …and the authenticated second key: never paid, whatever the owner list.

files.name: docs/MULTIMODEL.md
files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+# Several models on one hotkey, and a competition entry next to it (release 1.2.0rc10)
+
+From chain block **9331987** (about 13:00 UTC on 21 October 2026) one hotkey can
+
+* serve **several s1 models** behind one miner endpoint (`REAX_MODELS`), and
+* hold **one competition entry** (use-case/generalist track or engine track) next to its inference element ("dual role").
+
+Both start at the same block, `MULTIMODEL_START_BLOCK = DUALROLE_START_BLOCK = 9331987` in `elements.py` of the subnet release.
+Before it, one model per hotkey and one element per commitment: validators read no role from anything else. The miner image
+and `reax-commit` enforce this themselves (below), so the kit adds no block check of its own. Source of truth: "Several models
+on one hotkey" in `docs/MINER.md` of https://github.com/reaxlabs/reax-subnet and `docs/DESIGN-MULTIROLE.md` there.
+
+`reaxctl install` still installs **one pool** (one runtime sidecar, `REAX_MODEL`). For several models you run the same pinned
+images with a compose file that has one sidecar per model; [`service/docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml`](../service/docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml)
+is a complete example (s1-lite plus s1-cpu). Do not run `reaxctl install` again in the same state directory: it would render a
+single-pool `compose.yml` and `miner.env` over your own. `reaxctl verify` reads the multi-model `/health` and works against
+the pool you installed.
+
+## What the miner needs
+
+| Model | Sidecar image key (`releases/current.json`) | Port | Environment of the miner |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| s1-fast | `s1_fast_runtime` | 8101 | `REAX_S1_FAST_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8101` |
+| s1-pro | `s1_pro_runtime` | 8102 | `REAX_S1_PRO_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8102` |
+| s1-lite | `s1_lite_runtime` (`s1_lite_runtime_jetson` on a Jetson) | 8103 | `REAX_S1_LITE_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8103` |
+| s1-cpu | `s1_cpu_runtime` | 8104 | `REAX_S1_CPU_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8104` |
+
+* `REAX_MODELS=s1-lite,s1-cpu` (comma-separated, each model at most once, at least two; the first is the primary model). Leave
+  `REAX_MODEL` unset: if you set it, it must be in the list.
+* Every model has its **own sidecar**, own port and own weights directory, with the **same** `REAX_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE` token. Two
+  models must not share a URL. Hardware is per model: the sidecars together must fit the machine (you save registrations, not
+  hardware). Never publish the sidecar ports 8101-8104 or 8000.
+* Limits (`REAX_MAX_CONCURRENT`, `REAX_PER_CALLER_CONCURRENCY`, `REAX_PER_CALLER_PER_MINUTE`) apply **per model**, with the
+  image defaults 8 / 32 / 456.
+* `GET /health` on the miner port returns `{"protocol": "reax-s1/1", "version": ..., "models": {"<model>": "<manifest_id>", ...}}`.
+* The miner publishes `reax-s1m/1:<model>:<manifest_id>,<model>:<manifest_id>` on start (canonical order s1-fast, s1-pro,
+  s1-lite, s1-cpu); the manifest ids are the `manifest_id` values of the pools in `releases/current.json`. A competition
+  element already on the hotkey is kept.
+* **Before block 9331987** the miner refuses to start with two or more models (it exits with `refusing to start: ... count from
+  block 9331987`; with `restart: unless-stopped` it keeps restarting). Start it after the block, or keep the old single-model
+  setup until then. `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE=1` overrides this, and the same check in `reax-commit`, but nobody scores the result
+  before the start block: use it for local tests only, never on mainnet, and never from an agent.
+
+## Run it
+
+```sh
+export REAX_UID=$(id -u) REAX_GID=$(id -g) REAX_WALLET_NAME=<coldkey name> REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY=<hotkey name>
+cd <directory with the compose file>
+mkdir -p secrets && openssl rand -hex 32 > secrets/runtime-token && chmod 0600 secrets/runtime-token
+cp miner.env.example miner.env        # network, netuid, wallet and hotkey names, REAX_EXTERNAL_IP / PORT
+# weights: pinned revisions from releases/current.json (s1-lite and s1-cpu are public; s1-pro is gated: your own HF account)
+hf download crh225/plumb-4b-GGUF plumb-4b-v5-Q8_0.gguf --revision 71c1c57e523219124f7be9c486d475d19891185f --local-dir /srv/reax/s1-lite
+hf download kouhxp/gutsy gutsy-0.8b-v04-q8_0.gguf --revision f9995fe26a337f1a4ea3f1a5ed38c9799e5a8f63 --local-dir /srv/reax/s1-cpu
+REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-lite REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-cpu \
+  docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml up -d
+docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml logs miner | tail    # "published commitment reax-s1m/1:..."
+curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/health
+```
+
+Registration of the hotkey is a human step in your own wallet, as for one model (`reaxctl wallet`, https://reax.dev/register/).
+For another combination copy the sidecar block of each model from the table (s1-fast and s1-pro use `RUNE_HOST`/`RUNE_PORT`
+and the s1-pro compose file in this repository for the sidecar settings: `RUNE_DETERMINISTIC=1`, the gated weights).
+Run `reax-selfcheck --model <model>` per model before you register (see below).
+
+## Commands inside the miner image
+
+The miner image ships `reax-commit`, `reax-selfcheck` and `reax-engine-submit`. Run them with the compose file you use for the miner,
+so they get the same wallet mount, network and environment, and without starting another miner (`--no-deps`). `reax-selfcheck`
+needs the sidecar of that model to be running (`docker compose ... up -d runtime-s1-lite`):
+
+```sh
+C="docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml run --rm --no-deps"   # or: -f ~/.reax-miner/compose.yml (one-model install)
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner show                  # fields on chain and how this release reads them
+$C --entrypoint reax-selfcheck miner --model s1-lite --json
+```
+
+`reax-commit show` prints the fields on chain, whether validators read them at the current block, and per model whether the
+manifest id matches this release (`matches this release` / `STALE`).
+
+### Dual role: one competition entry next to inference
+
+Never write the competition entry with a hand-made `btcli` commit: every commitment write replaces all fields and would drop your
+inference element. Use the tools; they keep the other element:
+
+```sh
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner set "reax-spec/1:<track_id>:<owner>/<repo>@<40-hex revision>" --dry-run   # prints the fields it would write
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner set "reax-spec/1:<track_id>:<owner>/<repo>@<40-hex revision>"             # writes [inference element, new element]
+$C --entrypoint reax-engine-submit miner <image>@sha256:<64-hex digest> --dry-run                           # engine track instead (see below)
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner withdraw competition --dry-run                                           # removes only the competition element
+```
+
+* A commitment holds at most one inference and one competition element (three fields in total on finney). `set` replaces a
+  competition element of the same kind and keeps the inference element; the miner's own 10-minute re-publish touches only the
+  inference element, so the two never overwrite each other.
+* `reax-engine-submit` refuses on finney while the subnet owner holds the engine track closed; `--dry-run` only prints the
+  element text. Drop `--dry-run` to write it once the engine track is open.
+* The competition entry is evaluated on the subnet's own worker, never on your serving GPU. Track ids, rules, deadlines and
+  floors are on https://reax.co/competitions.
+* Before block 9331987 `set` and `reax-engine-submit` refuse when the other kind exists: the message offers `--replace-all`
+  (writes the new element alone and **drops the other one**, today's behaviour) or `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE=1`. Neither is needed
+  after the block. Always run `--dry-run` first and read the printed fields.
+* Changing a manifest id (a model or manifest change in an update) restarts that model's score; the kit's
+  `--accept-manifest-change` rule still applies to `reaxctl update`.
+
+## Rules for agents
+
+* Do not set `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE`, pass `--replace-all`, or write a competition element without the person's explicit approval of
+  the exact element text. Run `reax-commit ... --dry-run` and show the fields first.
+* A commitment write is signed with the hotkey; the coldkey is never involved and never needed. Do not mount a coldkey into a container.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+# Example: one hotkey serving two models (s1-lite + s1-cpu), release 1.2.0rc10. Walk-through: docs/MULTIMODEL.md.
+# Several models on one hotkey count from chain block 9331987 (about 13:00 UTC on 21 Oct 2026): start this stack after that
+# block (before it the miner refuses to start with two or more models). `reaxctl install` does NOT render this file.
+#
+# Prepare once (run as your own user, never as root; see docs/MULTIMODEL.md for the weights download commands):
+#   export REAX_UID=$(id -u) REAX_GID=$(id -g) REAX_WALLET_NAME=<coldkey name> REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY=<hotkey name>
+#   mkdir -p secrets && openssl rand -hex 32 > secrets/runtime-token && chmod 0600 secrets/runtime-token
+#   cp miner.env.example miner.env                 # REAX_NETWORK/NETUID, wallet + hotkey names, REAX_EXTERNAL_IP/PORT
+#   REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-lite REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-cpu docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml up -d
+#
+# The tag is mutable on GHCR: for a final release use the name@sha256:... digests from releases/current.json.
+# Another model: add its sidecar block (s1-fast 8101 / s1-pro 8102: copy service/docker-compose.s1-pro.yml and change port and
+# weights; they use RUNE_HOST / RUNE_PORT), list it in REAX_MODELS and add its REAX_<MODEL>_RUNTIME_URL. Every model needs its
+# own port and weights directory; the miner refuses two models on one URL. Never publish a sidecar port (8101-8104, 8000).
+services:
+  runtime-s1-lite:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-s1-lite-runtime:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release (Jetson: reax-s1-lite-runtime-jetson)
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    environment:
+      S1M_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE: /run/runtime-token
+      RUNTIME_HOST: 127.0.0.1          # loopback only
+      RUNTIME_PORT: "8103"
+      GGUF_MODEL_DIR: /model
+      GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "-1"
+    volumes:
+      - ./secrets/runtime-token:/run/runtime-token:ro
+      - ${REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS:?set REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS to the s1-lite weights directory}:/model:ro
+    deploy:
+      resources:
+        reservations:
+          devices: [{driver: nvidia, count: 1, capabilities: [gpu]}]
+    logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}}
+  runtime-s1-cpu:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-s1-cpu-runtime:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    environment:
+      S1M_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE: /run/runtime-token
+      RUNTIME_HOST: 127.0.0.1          # loopback only
+      RUNTIME_PORT: "8104"
+      GGUF_MODEL_DIR: /model
+      GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "0"
+    volumes:
+      - ./secrets/runtime-token:/run/runtime-token:ro
+      - ${REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS:?set REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS to the s1-cpu weights directory}:/model:ro
+    logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}}
+  miner:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-miner:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    env_file: miner.env
+    depends_on:
+      runtime-s1-lite:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      runtime-s1-cpu:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      REAX_MECHANISM: s1
+      REAX_MODELS: s1-lite,s1-cpu      # at least two, each once; leave REAX_MODEL unset (the first listed is the primary model)
+      REAX_S1_LITE_RUNTIME_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8103
+      REAX_S1_CPU_RUNTIME_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8104
+      REAX_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE: /run/reax-runtime-token
+      REAX_PUBLISH_COMMITMENT: "1"     # reax-s1m/1:s1-lite:8c7297e14e5e89bf,s1-cpu:f2c9981f0766f2a6
+    ulimits:
+      nofile: {soft: 65536, hard: 65536}
+    volumes:
+      # hotkey and public coldkey address only, read-only (the same mounts `reaxctl install` renders); no coldkey secret
+      - ${HOME}/.bittensor/wallets/${REAX_WALLET_NAME:?set REAX_WALLET_NAME}/hotkeys/${REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY:?set REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY}:/wallets/${REAX_WALLET_NAME}/hotkeys/${REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY}:ro
+      - ${HOME}/.bittensor/wallets/${REAX_WALLET_NAME}/coldkeypub.txt:/wallets/${REAX_WALLET_NAME}/coldkeypub.txt:ro
+      - ./secrets/runtime-token:/run/reax-runtime-token:ro
+    logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}}

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+import os as _os; _os.environ.setdefault("REAX_OFFLINE", "1")  # tests never touch the network
+import json
+import pathlib
+import re
+import unittest
+
+from reaxlib import cmd_install as install, descriptor
+
+ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+START_BLOCK = '9331987'
+
+
+def bundled():
+    return json.loads(descriptor.BUNDLED.read_text())
+
+
+class MultiModelTemplateTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.compose = (ROOT / 'service/docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml').read_text()
+        self.docs = (ROOT / 'docs/MULTIMODEL.md').read_text()
+        self.value = bundled()
+        self.pools = {p['id']: p for p in self.value['pools']}
+
+    def test_images_follow_the_bundled_release_tag(self):
+        tag = self.value['images']['tag']
+        for key in ('miner', 's1_lite_runtime', 's1_cpu_runtime'):
+            self.assertIn('image: %s:%s' % (self.value['images'][key], tag), self.compose)
+
+    def test_commitment_comment_matches_the_descriptor(self):
+        lite, cpu = self.pools['s1-lite'], self.pools['s1-cpu']
+        self.assertIn('reax-s1m/1:s1-lite:%s,s1-cpu:%s' % (lite['manifest_id'], cpu['manifest_id']), self.compose)
+
+    def test_each_model_has_its_own_loopback_sidecar_and_url(self):
+        for name, pool in (('S1_LITE', self.pools['s1-lite']), ('S1_CPU', self.pools['s1-cpu'])):
+            port = pool['sidecar_port']
+            self.assertIn('RUNTIME_PORT: "%d"' % port, self.compose)
+            self.assertIn('REAX_%s_RUNTIME_URL: http://127.0.0.1:%d' % (name, port), self.compose)
+        self.assertIn('REAX_MODELS: s1-lite,s1-cpu', self.compose)
+        self.assertEqual(self.compose.count('RUNTIME_HOST: 127.0.0.1'), 2)
+        self.assertNotIn('REAX_MODEL:', self.compose)
+        self.assertNotIn('ports:', self.compose)
+        self.assertNotIn('0.0.0.0', self.compose)
+        for port in install.SIDECAR_PORTS:
+            self.assertNotIn(':%d:' % port, self.compose)
+
+    def test_hardening_and_no_coldkey_secret(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.compose.count('cap_drop: [ALL]'), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(self.compose.count('no-new-privileges:true'), 3)
+        self.assertIn('hotkeys/${REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY', self.compose)
+        self.assertIn('coldkeypub.txt', self.compose)
+        self.assertNotRegex(self.compose, r'wallets:/wallets')  # never mount the whole wallet directory
+        self.assertNotIn('mnemonic', self.compose.lower())
+
+    def test_gpu_reservation_only_for_the_gpu_model(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.compose.count('driver: nvidia'), 1)
+        self.assertIn('GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "-1"', self.compose)
+        self.assertIn('GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "0"', self.compose)
+
+    def test_docs_name_the_start_block_and_the_tools(self):
+        for text in (self.docs, self.compose, (ROOT / 'README.md').read_text()):
+            self.assertIn(START_BLOCK, text)
+        for needle in ('REAX_MODELS', 'reax-commit', 'reax-selfcheck', '--dry-run', 'withdraw competition', '--no-deps',
+                       'REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE', 'reax-s1m/1', 'hand-made `btcli` commit'):
+            self.assertIn(needle, self.docs)
+
+    def test_docs_table_matches_descriptor_ports_and_images(self):
+        for pool_id, key in (('s1-fast', 's1_fast_runtime'), ('s1-pro', 's1_pro_runtime'), ('s1-lite', 's1_lite_runtime'), ('s1-cpu', 's1_cpu_runtime')):
+            row = next(line for line in self.docs.splitlines() if line.startswith('| ' + pool_id + ' '))
+            self.assertIn('`%s`' % key, row)
+            self.assertIn(str(self.pools[pool_id]['sidecar_port']), row)
+
+    def test_docs_have_no_money_wording(self):
+        text = (self.docs + self.compose).lower()
+        for word in ('earn', 'profit', 'income', 'revenue', 'return on', 'reward', 'price', ' pay'):
+            self.assertNotIn(word, text)
+
+    def test_weights_commands_use_the_pinned_revisions(self):
+        for pool_id in ('s1-lite', 's1-cpu'):
+            w = self.pools[pool_id]['weights']
+            self.assertIn('hf download %s %s --revision %s' % (w['repo'], w['files'][0], w['revision']), self.docs)
+
+
+class BundledDescriptorTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_bundled_copy_is_live_so_the_offline_fallback_does_not_block_mainnet(self):
+        value = descriptor.validate(bundled())
+        self.assertEqual(value['release_id'], '1.2.0rc10.post1')
+        self.assertTrue(value['status']['live'])
+        self.assertEqual((value['status']['launch_status'], value['status']['network'], value['status']['netuid']), ('live', 'finney', 92))
+        self.assertIsNone(install.gate(value, 'mainnet', confirm=True))
+
+    def test_minimum_release_is_unchanged(self):
+        self.assertEqual(bundled()['minimum_release'], '1.1.0rc2')
+
+
+class StartBlockIsNotGatedInTheKitTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_kit_has_no_block_gate_of_its_own(self):
+        # The start block is enforced by the miner image and reax-commit (elements.py of the subnet release); the kit
+        # must not carry a second copy that could drift from it.
+        for path in list((ROOT / 'reaxlib').glob('*.py')) + [ROOT / 'reaxctl']:
+            self.assertNotIn(START_BLOCK, path.read_text(), str(path))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+- From chain block 9331987 one hotkey may serve several s1 models and hold one competition entry ([docs/MULTIMODEL.md](docs/MULTIMODEL.md)). `reaxctl install` stays single-pool: never run it over a multi-model `compose.yml` / `miner.env`.
+- Write competition elements only with `reax-commit set` / `reax-engine-submit` from the miner image (they keep the inference element), never with a hand-made `btcli` commit. Run `--dry-run` first and show the fields to the person.
+- Never set `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE=1` or pass `--replace-all` on mainnet without the person's explicit approval of the exact fields; both bypass the start-block protection and `--replace-all` drops the other element.
+
 See the [README security model](README.md#security-model) for fetch limits, source pins, container settings and documented runtime limitations.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+# Several models on one hotkey, and a competition entry next to it (release 1.2.0rc10)
+
+From chain block **9331987** (about 13:00 UTC on 21 October 2026) one hotkey can
+
+* serve **several s1 models** behind one miner endpoint (`REAX_MODELS`), and
+* hold **one competition entry** (use-case/generalist track or engine track) next to its inference element ("dual role").
+
+Both start at the same block, `MULTIMODEL_START_BLOCK = DUALROLE_START_BLOCK = 9331987` in `elements.py` of the subnet release.
+Before it, one model per hotkey and one element per commitment: validators read no role from anything else. The miner image
+and `reax-commit` enforce this themselves (below), so the kit adds no block check of its own. Source of truth: "Several models
+on one hotkey" in `docs/MINER.md` of https://github.com/reaxlabs/reax-subnet and `docs/DESIGN-MULTIROLE.md` there.
+
+`reaxctl install` still installs **one pool** (one runtime sidecar, `REAX_MODEL`). For several models you run the same pinned
+images with a compose file that has one sidecar per model; [`service/docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml`](../service/docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml)
+is a complete example (s1-lite plus s1-cpu). Do not run `reaxctl install` again in the same state directory: it would render a
+single-pool `compose.yml` and `miner.env` over your own. `reaxctl verify` reads the multi-model `/health` and works against
+the pool you installed.
+
+## What the miner needs
+
+| Model | Sidecar image key (`releases/current.json`) | Port | Environment of the miner |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| s1-fast | `s1_fast_runtime` | 8101 | `REAX_S1_FAST_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8101` |
+| s1-pro | `s1_pro_runtime` | 8102 | `REAX_S1_PRO_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8102` |
+| s1-lite | `s1_lite_runtime` (`s1_lite_runtime_jetson` on a Jetson) | 8103 | `REAX_S1_LITE_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8103` |
+| s1-cpu | `s1_cpu_runtime` | 8104 | `REAX_S1_CPU_RUNTIME_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8104` |
+
+* `REAX_MODELS=s1-lite,s1-cpu` (comma-separated, each model at most once, at least two; the first is the primary model). Leave
+  `REAX_MODEL` unset: if you set it, it must be in the list.
+* Every model has its **own sidecar**, own port and own weights directory, with the **same** `REAX_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE` token. Two
+  models must not share a URL. Hardware is per model: the sidecars together must fit the machine (you save registrations, not
+  hardware). Never publish the sidecar ports 8101-8104 or 8000.
+* Limits (`REAX_MAX_CONCURRENT`, `REAX_PER_CALLER_CONCURRENCY`, `REAX_PER_CALLER_PER_MINUTE`) apply **per model**, with the
+  image defaults 8 / 32 / 456.
+* `GET /health` on the miner port returns `{"protocol": "reax-s1/1", "version": ..., "models": {"<model>": "<manifest_id>", ...}}`.
+* The miner publishes `reax-s1m/1:<model>:<manifest_id>,<model>:<manifest_id>` on start (canonical order s1-fast, s1-pro,
+  s1-lite, s1-cpu); the manifest ids are the `manifest_id` values of the pools in `releases/current.json`. A competition
+  element already on the hotkey is kept.
+* **Before block 9331987** the miner refuses to start with two or more models (it exits with `refusing to start: ... count from
+  block 9331987`; with `restart: unless-stopped` it keeps restarting). Start it after the block, or keep the old single-model
+  setup until then. `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE=1` overrides this, and the same check in `reax-commit`, but nobody scores the result
+  before the start block: use it for local tests only, never on mainnet, and never from an agent.
+
+## Run it
+
+```sh
+export REAX_UID=$(id -u) REAX_GID=$(id -g) REAX_WALLET_NAME=<coldkey name> REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY=<hotkey name>
+cd <directory with the compose file>
+mkdir -p secrets && openssl rand -hex 32 > secrets/runtime-token && chmod 0600 secrets/runtime-token
+cp miner.env.example miner.env        # network, netuid, wallet and hotkey names, REAX_EXTERNAL_IP / PORT
+# weights: pinned revisions from releases/current.json (s1-lite and s1-cpu are public; s1-pro is gated: your own HF account)
+hf download crh225/plumb-4b-GGUF plumb-4b-v5-Q8_0.gguf --revision 71c1c57e523219124f7be9c486d475d19891185f --local-dir /srv/reax/s1-lite
+hf download kouhxp/gutsy gutsy-0.8b-v04-q8_0.gguf --revision f9995fe26a337f1a4ea3f1a5ed38c9799e5a8f63 --local-dir /srv/reax/s1-cpu
+REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-lite REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-cpu \
+  docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml up -d
+docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml logs miner | tail    # "published commitment reax-s1m/1:..."
+curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/health
+```
+
+Registration of the hotkey is a human step in your own wallet, as for one model (`reaxctl wallet`, https://reax.dev/register/).
+For another combination copy the sidecar block of each model from the table (s1-fast and s1-pro use `RUNE_HOST`/`RUNE_PORT`
+and the s1-pro compose file in this repository for the sidecar settings: `RUNE_DETERMINISTIC=1`, the gated weights).
+Run `reax-selfcheck --model <model>` per model before you register (see below).
+
+## Commands inside the miner image
+
+The miner image ships `reax-commit`, `reax-selfcheck` and `reax-engine-submit`. Run them with the compose file you use for the miner,
+so they get the same wallet mount, network and environment, and without starting another miner (`--no-deps`). `reax-selfcheck`
+needs the sidecar of that model to be running (`docker compose ... up -d runtime-s1-lite`):
+
+```sh
+C="docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml run --rm --no-deps"   # or: -f ~/.reax-miner/compose.yml (one-model install)
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner show                  # fields on chain and how this release reads them
+$C --entrypoint reax-selfcheck miner --model s1-lite --json
+```
+
+`reax-commit show` prints the fields on chain, whether validators read them at the current block, and per model whether the
+manifest id matches this release (`matches this release` / `STALE`).
+
+### Dual role: one competition entry next to inference
+
+Never write the competition entry with a hand-made `btcli` commit: every commitment write replaces all fields and would drop your
+inference element. Use the tools; they keep the other element:
+
+```sh
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner set "reax-spec/1:<track_id>:<owner>/<repo>@<40-hex revision>" --dry-run   # prints the fields it would write
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner set "reax-spec/1:<track_id>:<owner>/<repo>@<40-hex revision>"             # writes [inference element, new element]
+$C --entrypoint reax-engine-submit miner <image>@sha256:<64-hex digest> --dry-run                           # engine track instead (see below)
+$C --entrypoint reax-commit miner withdraw competition --dry-run                                           # removes only the competition element
+```
+
+* A commitment holds at most one inference and one competition element (three fields in total on finney). `set` replaces a
+  competition element of the same kind and keeps the inference element; the miner's own 10-minute re-publish touches only the
+  inference element, so the two never overwrite each other.
+* `reax-engine-submit` refuses on finney while the subnet owner holds the engine track closed; `--dry-run` only prints the
+  element text. Drop `--dry-run` to write it once the engine track is open.
+* The competition entry is evaluated on the subnet's own worker, never on your serving GPU. Track ids, rules, deadlines and
+  floors are on https://reax.co/competitions.
+* Before block 9331987 `set` and `reax-engine-submit` refuse when the other kind exists: the message offers `--replace-all`
+  (writes the new element alone and **drops the other one**, today's behaviour) or `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE=1`. Neither is needed
+  after the block. Always run `--dry-run` first and read the printed fields.
+* Changing a manifest id (a model or manifest change in an update) restarts that model's score; the kit's
+  `--accept-manifest-change` rule still applies to `reaxctl update`.
+
+## Rules for agents
+
+* Do not set `REAX_FORCE_MULTIROLE`, pass `--replace-all`, or write a competition element without the person's explicit approval of
+  the exact element text. Run `reax-commit ... --dry-run` and show the fields first.
+* A commitment write is signed with the hotkey; the coldkey is never involved and never needed. Do not mount a coldkey into a container.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+# Example: one hotkey serving two models (s1-lite + s1-cpu), release 1.2.0rc10. Walk-through: docs/MULTIMODEL.md.
+# Several models on one hotkey count from chain block 9331987 (about 13:00 UTC on 21 Oct 2026): start this stack after that
+# block (before it the miner refuses to start with two or more models). `reaxctl install` does NOT render this file.
+#
+# Prepare once (run as your own user, never as root; see docs/MULTIMODEL.md for the weights download commands):
+#   export REAX_UID=$(id -u) REAX_GID=$(id -g) REAX_WALLET_NAME=<coldkey name> REAX_WALLET_HOTKEY=<hotkey name>
+#   mkdir -p secrets && openssl rand -hex 32 > secrets/runtime-token && chmod 0600 secrets/runtime-token
+#   cp miner.env.example miner.env                 # REAX_NETWORK/NETUID, wallet + hotkey names, REAX_EXTERNAL_IP/PORT
+#   REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-lite REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS=/srv/reax/s1-cpu docker compose -f docker-compose.multimodel.example.yml up -d
+#
+# The tag is mutable on GHCR: for a final release use the name@sha256:... digests from releases/current.json.
+# Another model: add its sidecar block (s1-fast 8101 / s1-pro 8102: copy service/docker-compose.s1-pro.yml and change port and
+# weights; they use RUNE_HOST / RUNE_PORT), list it in REAX_MODELS and add its REAX_<MODEL>_RUNTIME_URL. Every model needs its
+# own port and weights directory; the miner refuses two models on one URL. Never publish a sidecar port (8101-8104, 8000).
+services:
+  runtime-s1-lite:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-s1-lite-runtime:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release (Jetson: reax-s1-lite-runtime-jetson)
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    environment:
+      S1M_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE: /run/runtime-token
+      RUNTIME_HOST: 127.0.0.1          # loopback only
+      RUNTIME_PORT: "8103"
+      GGUF_MODEL_DIR: /model
+      GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "-1"
+    volumes:
+      - ./secrets/runtime-token:/run/runtime-token:ro
+      - ${REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS:?set REAX_S1_LITE_WEIGHTS to the s1-lite weights directory}:/model:ro
+    deploy:
+      resources:
+        reservations:
+          devices: [{driver: nvidia, count: 1, capabilities: [gpu]}]
+    logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}}
+  runtime-s1-cpu:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-s1-cpu-runtime:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    environment:
+      S1M_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE: /run/runtime-token
+      RUNTIME_HOST: 127.0.0.1          # loopback only
+      RUNTIME_PORT: "8104"
+      GGUF_MODEL_DIR: /model
+      GGUF_N_GPU_LAYERS: "0"
+    volumes:
+      - ./secrets/runtime-token:/run/runtime-token:ro
+      - ${REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS:?set REAX_S1_CPU_WEIGHTS to the s1-cpu weights directory}:/model:ro
+    logging: {driver: json-file, options: {max-size: "50m", max-file: "5"}}
+  miner:
+    image: ghcr.io/reaxlabs/reax-miner:1.2.0-rc10.post1   # pin by digest for a final release
+    user: "${REAX_UID:?set REAX_UID=$(id -u)}:${REAX_GID:?set REAX_GID=$(id -g)}"
+    init: true
+    network_mode: host
+    restart: unless-stopped
+    cap_drop: [ALL]
+    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
+    env_file: miner.env
+    depends_on:
+      runtime-s1-lite:
+        condition: service_healthy
+      runtime-s1-cpu:
+        condition: service_healthy
+    environment:
+      REAX_MECHANISM: s1
+      REAX_MODELS: s1-lite,s1-cpu      # at least two, each once; leave REAX_MODEL unset (the first listed is the primary model)
+      REAX_S1_LITE_RUNTIME_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8103
+      REAX_S1_CPU_RUNTIME_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8104
+      REAX_RUNTIME_TOKEN_FILE: /run/reax-runtime-token
+      REAX_PUBLISH_COMMITMENT: "1"     # reax-s1m/1:s1-lite:8c7297e14e5e89bf,s1-cpu:f2c9981f0766f2a6
+    ulimits:
+      nofile: {soft: 65536, hard: 65536}
+    volumes:
+      # hotkey and public coldkey address only, read-only (the same mounts `reaxctl install` renders); no coldkey secret

@@ -0,0 +1,174 @@
+"""Read-only public-metadata preflight; never unlock, create or replace a key."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import os
+import stat
+import json
+
+MAX_KEYFILE_BYTES = 64_000
+PUBLIC_FIELDS = {"cryptoType", "publicKey", "accountId", "ss58Address"}
+
+
+class WalletConfigurationError(ValueError):
+    def __init__(self, code, paths=None):
+        super().__init__(code)
+        self.paths = paths or {}
+
+
+def wallet_paths(wallet):
+    return {
+        "walletPath": str(Path(wallet.path).expanduser().absolute()),
+        "hotkeyFile": str(Path(wallet.hotkey_file.path).expanduser().absolute()),
+        "publicHotkeyFile": str(Path(wallet.hotkeypub_file.path).expanduser().absolute()),
+    }
+
+
+def regular_file(path):
+    try:
+        return stat.S_ISREG(Path(path).stat().st_mode)
+    except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError):
+        return False
+
+
+def public_metadata(path):
+    """Read a bounded existing keyfile and construct a PUBLIC-ONLY keypair.
+
+    Legacy hotkeys contain public fields alongside their private fields. Never
+    pass the document or any secret fields to a keypair deserializer, never
+    decrypt, and never include the raw file in diagnostics.
+    """
+    from bittensor.keyfiles import Keypair, keyfile_data_is_encrypted
+    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
+    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as file:
+        info = os.fstat(file.fileno())
+        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_size > MAX_KEYFILE_BYTES:
+            raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+        raw = file.read(MAX_KEYFILE_BYTES + 1)
+    if len(raw) > MAX_KEYFILE_BYTES:
+        raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+    if keyfile_data_is_encrypted(raw):
+        return None, True
+
+    def public_fields(pairs):
+        result = {}
+        for name, value in pairs:
+            if name in PUBLIC_FIELDS:
+                if name in result:
+                    raise ValueError("duplicate_public_metadata")
+                result[name] = value
+        return result
+
+    try:
+        data = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=public_fields)
+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeError):
+        return None, False
+    if not isinstance(data, dict):
+        return None, False
+    kind = data.get("cryptoType", 1)  # Legacy Bittensor keys default to sr25519.
+    if type(kind) is not int or kind not in (0, 1):
+        raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+    public_values = [data[name] for name in ("publicKey", "accountId") if data.get(name)]
+    address = data.get("ss58Address")
+    if not public_values and not address:
+        return None, False
+    pair = None
+    for value in public_values:
+        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value.removeprefix("0x")) != 64:
+            raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+        candidate = Keypair(public_key=bytes.fromhex(value.removeprefix("0x")),
+                            crypto_type=kind, ss58_format=42)
+        if pair is not None and candidate.public_key != pair.public_key:
+            raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+        pair = candidate
+    if address:
+        if not isinstance(address, str):
+            raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+        candidate = Keypair(ss58_address=address, crypto_type=kind, ss58_format=42)
+        if pair is not None and candidate.public_key != pair.public_key:
+            raise ValueError("invalid_public_metadata")
+        pair = candidate
+    return pair.ss58_address, False
+
+
+def wallet_identity(wallet):
+    address, encrypted = public_metadata(wallet.hotkey_file.path)
+    if address is not None:
+        return {"address": address, "publicIdentitySource": "hotkey_metadata",
+                "publicIdentityVerified": True}
+    # Sidecars remain an optional source for encrypted/metadata-less wallets,
+    # not a mandatory Bittensor wallet format and never a password prompt.
+    if regular_file(wallet.hotkeypub_file.path):
+        address, _ = public_metadata(wallet.hotkeypub_file.path)
+        if address is not None:
+            return {"address": address, "publicIdentitySource": "public_sidecar",
+                    "publicIdentityVerified": True}
+    if encrypted:
+        return {"address": None, "publicIdentitySource": "encrypted_hotkey",
+                "publicIdentityVerified": False}
+    raise ValueError("public_metadata_unavailable")
+
+
+def checked_wallet(config, *, with_identity=False):
+    """Check file presence and public metadata, without unlocking a private key.
+
+    walletPath is a parent containing wallet directories. A likely correction is
+    only a diagnostic hint, never an automatic configuration or identity change.
+    The signing path must still unlock and check the actual signer separately.
+    """
+    if not config.get("wallet"):
+        raise ValueError("wallet_not_configured")
+    import bittensor as bt
+
+    path = config.get("walletPath")
+    if path is not None:
+        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path or "\x00" in path or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in path):
+            raise WalletConfigurationError("invalid_wallet_path")
+        path = str(Path(path).expanduser())
+        if not Path(path).is_absolute():
+            raise WalletConfigurationError("invalid_wallet_path")
+    try:
+        wallet = bt.Wallet(config["wallet"], config.get("walletHotkey", "default"),
+                           **({"path": path} if path is not None else {}))
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        raise WalletConfigurationError("invalid_wallet_configuration") from None
+    paths = wallet_paths(wallet)
+    try:
+        private_exists = regular_file(paths["hotkeyFile"])
+        root = Path(paths["walletPath"])
+        if not private_exists and root.name == wallet.name:
+            candidate = bt.Wallet(wallet.name, wallet.hotkey_str, path=str(root.parent))
+            # Confirm a matching public identity before suggesting another root.
+            # Only public metadata is used; no key unlock or signing.
+            try:
+                if (regular_file(candidate.hotkey_file.path)
+                        and wallet_identity(candidate)["address"] == config["validatorHotkey"]):
+                    raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_path_includes_name",
+                                                   {**paths, "suggestedWalletPath": str(root.parent)})
+            except WalletConfigurationError:
+                raise
+            except Exception:
+                pass  # An unreadable/nonmatching alternative is never selected.
+        if not private_exists:
+            raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_hotkey_missing", paths)
+        if not os.access(paths["hotkeyFile"], os.R_OK):
+            raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_file_unreadable", paths)
+    except PermissionError:
+        raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_file_unreadable", paths) from None
+    try:
+        identity = wallet_identity(wallet)
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_hotkey_missing", paths) from None
+    except PermissionError:
+        raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_file_unreadable", paths) from None
+    except Exception:
+        raise WalletConfigurationError("wallet_public_metadata_invalid", paths) from None
+    if identity["address"] is not None and identity["address"] != config["validatorHotkey"]:
+        raise ValueError("wallet does not match intended validator")
+    return (wallet, identity) if with_identity else wallet
+
+
+def check_signer(signer, expected):
+    """A public sidecar is not proof of the private signing key's identity."""
+    if signer.ss58_address != expected:
+        raise ValueError("wallet does not match intended validator")
+    return signer

+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import bittensor as bt
+from bittensor.keyfiles import Keypair, serialized_keypair_to_keyfile_data
+import pytest
+
+from conftest import hot
+from everyframe_validator import cli
+from everyframe_validator.diagnostics import diagnostic
+from everyframe_validator.doctor import doctor
+from everyframe_validator.feed import PROFILES
+from everyframe_validator.state import initialize
+from everyframe_validator.wallet import (
+    WalletConfigurationError, checked_wallet, check_signer, wallet_paths,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def real_wallet(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    root = tmp_path / "wallets"
+    keydir = root / "default" / "hotkeys"
+    keydir.mkdir(parents=True)
+    private = keydir / "default"
+    public = keydir / "defaultpub.txt"
+    metadata = json.loads(bytes(serialized_keypair_to_keyfile_data(Keypair(ss58_address=hot(1)))))
+    public.write_text(json.dumps(metadata))
+    private.write_text(json.dumps({**metadata, "secretSeed": "SECRET_SENTINEL_NEVER_UNLOCKED",
+                                  "secretPhrase": "SECRET_SENTINEL_NEVER_PRINTED"}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bt.Wallet, "get_hotkey", lambda *_: pytest.fail("private key unlock"))
+    return {**PROFILES["mainnet"], "validatorHotkey": hot(1), "wallet": "default",
+            "walletHotkey": "default", "walletPath": str(root), "walletPasswordFile": None}, private, public
+
+
+def test_real_sdk_parent_resolves_without_deserializing_private_key(real_wallet, monkeypatch):
+    config, private, _ = real_wallet
+    from bittensor.keyfiles import Keyfile
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Keyfile, "get_keypair", lambda *_: pytest.fail("keyfile private-key deserialization"))
+    paths = wallet_paths(checked_wallet(config))
+    assert paths["hotkeyFile"] == str(private)
+    assert paths["publicHotkeyFile"] == str(private) + "pub.txt"
+
+
+def test_duplicate_wallet_root_is_reported_without_repair(real_wallet):
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    before = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in (private, public)}
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError) as error:
+        checked_wallet(config)
+    out = diagnostic(error.value)
+    assert out["code"] == "wallet_path_includes_name"
+    assert out["walletPaths"]["suggestedWalletPath"] == str(private.parents[2])
+    assert out["walletPaths"]["hotkeyFile"].endswith("/default/default/hotkeys/default")
+    assert config["walletPath"].endswith("/default")
+    assert {p: p.read_bytes() for p in before} == before
+
+
+def test_missing_private_hotkey_is_distinguished(real_wallet):
+    real_wallet[1].unlink()
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError) as error:
+        checked_wallet(real_wallet[0])
+    assert diagnostic(error.value)["code"] == "wallet_hotkey_missing"
+    assert diagnostic(error.value)["walletPaths"]["hotkeyFile"] == str(real_wallet[1])
+
+
+def test_legacy_private_only_wallet_does_not_generate_public_sidecar(real_wallet):
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    public.unlink()
+    before = private.read_bytes()
+    _, identity = checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)
+    assert identity["publicIdentitySource"] == "hotkey_metadata"
+    assert identity["publicIdentityVerified"] and identity["address"] == config["validatorHotkey"]
+    assert not public.exists() and private.read_bytes() == before
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fields", [("ss58Address",), ("publicKey",), ("accountId",),
+                                  ("publicKey", "accountId", "ss58Address")])
+def test_legacy_public_field_variants_without_sidecar(real_wallet, fields):
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    metadata = json.loads(private.read_text())
+    private.write_text(json.dumps({k: metadata[k] for k in (*fields, "secretSeed", "secretPhrase")}))
+    public.unlink()
+    assert checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)[1]["publicIdentitySource"] == "hotkey_metadata"
+
+
+def test_public_identity_must_match(real_wallet):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["validatorHotkey"] = hot(2)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="wallet does not match"):
+        checked_wallet(config)
+
+
+def test_nonmatching_alternative_is_not_suggested(real_wallet):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    config["validatorHotkey"] = hot(2)
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError) as error:
+        checked_wallet(config)
+    assert error.value.args[0] == "wallet_hotkey_missing"
+    assert "suggestedWalletPath" not in error.value.paths
+
+
+def test_intentional_nested_wallet_layout_is_not_rewritten(real_wallet):
+    config, _, public = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    nested = Path(config["walletPath"]) / "default" / "hotkeys"
+    nested.mkdir(parents=True)
+    (nested / "default").write_bytes(b"metadata only")
+    (nested / "defaultpub.txt").write_bytes(public.read_bytes())
+    assert wallet_paths(checked_wallet(config))["hotkeyFile"] == str(nested / "default")
+    assert config["walletPath"].endswith("/default")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["wallets", "", "bad\npath", "bad\x00path"])
+def test_invalid_roots_are_rejected_without_creation(real_wallet, path):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] = path
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError, match="invalid_wallet_path"):
+        checked_wallet(config)
+
+
+def test_public_metadata_errors_do_not_leak_secrets(real_wallet):
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    private.write_text(json.dumps({"publicKey": "invalid", "secretSeed": "private-untrusted-content"}))
+    public.unlink()
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError) as error:
+        checked_wallet(config)
+    out = diagnostic(error.value)
+    assert out["code"] == "wallet_public_metadata_invalid"
+    assert "private-untrusted-content" not in json.dumps(out)
+
+
+def test_unreadable_private_file_is_caught_without_opening(real_wallet, monkeypatch):
+    import os
+    config, private, _ = real_wallet
+    original = os.access
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "access", lambda path, mode: False if Path(path) == private else original(path, mode))
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError, match="wallet_file_unreadable"):
+        checked_wallet(config)
+
+
+def test_encrypted_hotkey_without_sidecar_defers_identity_without_unlock(real_wallet, monkeypatch):
+    import bittensor.keyfiles as keyfiles
+    from bittensor.keyfiles import Keyfile
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    private.write_bytes(b"ENCRYPTED_FIXTURE")
+    public.unlink()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(keyfiles, "keyfile_data_is_encrypted", lambda data: data == b"ENCRYPTED_FIXTURE")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Keyfile, "get_keypair", lambda *_: pytest.fail("keyfile unlock"))
+    _, identity = checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)
+    assert identity == {"address": None, "publicIdentitySource": "encrypted_hotkey",
+                        "publicIdentityVerified": False}
+
+
+def test_encrypted_hotkey_can_use_optional_public_sidecar(real_wallet, monkeypatch):
+    import bittensor.keyfiles as keyfiles
+    config, private, _ = real_wallet
+    private.write_bytes(b"ENCRYPTED_FIXTURE")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(keyfiles, "keyfile_data_is_encrypted", lambda data: data == b"ENCRYPTED_FIXTURE")
+    identity = checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)[1]
+    assert identity["publicIdentityVerified"] and identity["publicIdentitySource"] == "public_sidecar"
+
+
+def test_private_public_field_conflicts_are_rejected(real_wallet):
+    config, private, _ = real_wallet
+    metadata = json.loads(private.read_text())
+    metadata["ss58Address"] = hot(2)
+    private.write_text(json.dumps(metadata))
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError, match="wallet_public_metadata_invalid"):
+        checked_wallet(config)
+
+
+def test_broken_optional_sidecar_is_not_needed_for_valid_legacy_hotkey(real_wallet):
+    config, _, public = real_wallet
+    public.write_bytes(b"irrelevant malformed sidecar")
+    assert checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)[1]["publicIdentitySource"] == "hotkey_metadata"
+
+
+def test_fifo_is_not_opened(real_wallet):
+    import os
+    config, private, _ = real_wallet
+    private.unlink()
+    os.mkfifo(private)
+    with pytest.raises(WalletConfigurationError, match="wallet_hotkey_missing"):
+        checked_wallet(config)
+
+
+def test_legacy_wallet_doctor_never_creates_sidecar_or_changes_state(real_wallet, tmp_path):
+    config, private, public = real_wallet
+    public.unlink()
+    state = tmp_path / "legacy-state"
+    initialize(state, config)
+    before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()}
+    private_before = private.read_bytes()
+    report = asyncio.run(doctor(state, offline=True))
+    assert report["ok"] is True
+    check = next(c for c in report["checks"] if c["name"] == "wallet")
+    assert check["publicIdentitySource"] == "hotkey_metadata"
+    assert "SECRET_SENTINEL" not in json.dumps(report)
+    assert not public.exists() and private.read_bytes() == private_before
+    assert {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()} == before
+
+
+def test_private_signer_must_match_even_if_sidecar_matches():

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("encrypted", [False, True])
+def test_real_sdk_existing_signer_works_without_sidecar(tmp_path, monkeypatch, encrypted):
+    # Publicly known fixture seed, never a real wallet or a chain transaction.
+    key = Keypair.from_seed(bytes([17]) * 32)
+    root = tmp_path / "fixture-wallets"
+    wallet = bt.Wallet("fixture", "default", path=str(root))
+    wallet.hotkey_file.set_keypair(key, encrypt=encrypted, password="fixture-password")
+    config = {"wallet": "fixture", "walletHotkey": "default", "walletPath": str(root),
+              "validatorHotkey": key.ss58_address}
+    before = Path(wallet.hotkey_file.path).read_bytes()
+    with monkeypatch.context() as guard:
+        guard.setattr(bt.Wallet, "get_hotkey", lambda *_: pytest.fail("preflight unlock"))
+        checked, identity = checked_wallet(config, with_identity=True)
+    assert identity["publicIdentityVerified"] is not encrypted
+    signer = checked.get_hotkey("fixture-password" if encrypted else None)
+    assert check_signer(signer, config["validatorHotkey"]).ss58_address == key.ss58_address
+    assert not Path(wallet.hotkeypub_file.path).exists()
+    assert Path(wallet.hotkey_file.path).read_bytes() == before

+
+def test_init_rejects_duplicate_before_creating_state(real_wallet, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):

+    state = tmp_path / "new-state"

+    assert not state.exists()

+
+def test_init_accepts_valid_readonly_checked_wallet(real_wallet, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    state = tmp_path / "new-state"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["validator", "init", "--state-dir", str(state),
+        "--validator-hotkey", config["validatorHotkey"], "--wallet", "default",
+        "--wallet-path", config["walletPath"]])
+    cli.main()
+    assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["state"] == "initialized"
+    assert not (state / "authorization.json").exists()

+
+def test_authorize_bad_profile_cannot_create_consent_or_rewrite_state(real_wallet, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    state = tmp_path / "existing"
+    initialize(state, config)
+    before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["validator", "authorize", "--state-dir", str(state), "--yes"])
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as error:
+        cli.main()
+    assert error.value.code == 2
+    assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["code"] == "wallet_path_includes_name"
+    assert {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()} == before
+
+
+def test_doctor_marks_configured_wallet_failure_not_ok(real_wallet, tmp_path):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    state = tmp_path / "existing"
+    initialize(state, config)
+    before = {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()}
+    report = asyncio.run(doctor(state, offline=True))
+    assert report["ok"] is False and report["readOnlyOk"] is True
+    assert report["signingPrerequisitesOk"] is None
+    check = next(c for c in report["checks"] if c["name"] == "wallet")
+    assert check["required"] and check["code"] == "wallet_path_includes_name"
+    assert {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in state.iterdir()} == before
+
+
+def test_readonly_profile_without_wallet_is_still_supported(tmp_path):
+    state = tmp_path / "readonly"
+    initialize(state, {**PROFILES["mainnet"], "validatorHotkey": hot(1), "wallet": None})
+    report = asyncio.run(doctor(state, offline=True))
+    assert report["ok"] and report["readOnlyOk"]
+
+
+def test_doctor_cli_returns_failure_for_configured_bad_wallet(real_wallet, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    config, _, _ = real_wallet
+    config["walletPath"] += "/default"
+    state = tmp_path / "existing"
+    initialize(state, config)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["validator", "doctor", "--state-dir", str(state), "--offline"])
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as error:
+        cli.main()
+    assert error.value.code == 2
+    out = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
+    assert out["ok"] is False and out["readOnlyOk"] is True
+    assert any(c.get("code") == "wallet_path_includes_name" for c in out["checks"])

+release; the fix alone does not change the task.
+
+Bars for this release (all on the live mix):
+
+| Bar | Target | v0.5.0 | Met |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| obs-only scripted controllers | ≤ ~0.25 | best 0.210 (`obs_refport`), others ≤ 0.09; top round-5 scripted submissions 0.010–0.019 | yes |
+| privileged solver | 0.5–0.75 | 0.697 | yes |
+| quick PPO beats best scripted | significant margin | not demonstrated (see below) | **no (open)** |
+| eval wall time, 64 episodes, 2 CPU | ≪ 1800 s | 154 s (`tools/local_run.py`, baseline.onnx, `taskset -c 0-1`) | yes |
+
+`obs_refport` is the privileged reference's insertion logic driven only by the
+observation (smoothed slot/peg estimates, no family knowledge, no true state). With
+zero estimate error it scores ~0.46, so the remaining gap to the reference (0.70) is the
+cost of the per-slot/per-peg estimate biases and per-episode layouts, which a policy must
+learn to compensate for from contact and motion rather than from a fixed template.
+
+## Reserved split
+
+Throwaway build secret (the real secret is never used here). Privileged reference on the
+reserved split, seeds 1–2, 128 episodes: **0.727** (easy 0.87 / medium 0.74 / hard 0.62).
+Held-out families are solvable: peg seat rate stadium 0.76, trapezoid 0.74 (live families
+0.72–0.92).
+
+## Quick PPO (paired, same 128 episodes, `tools/train_ppo.py`)
+
+| Run | Base | Steps | PPO | Base score | Δ (paired se) |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| residual on obs-only scripted | `ObsOnlyScripted` | 300k | 0.091 | 0.086 | +0.004 (0.007) |
+| residual on obs-only scripted | `ObsOnlyScripted` | 1M | 0.086 | 0.086 | −0.001 (0.005) |
+| residual on obs reference port, privileged shaping (train only) | `obs_refport` | 300k | 0.197 | 0.199 | −0.003 (0.010) |
+| insert-phase-only residual, scale 0.5 | `obs_refport` | 400k | 0.179 | 0.199 | −0.021 (0.013) |
+
+None of the quick runs (≤ 1M steps, CPU, a few tens of minutes) produce a significant
+gain over its scripted base. This is reported as an **open trade-off**: v0.5.0 removes
+the advantage of fixed-template scripting (the scripted ceiling drops from ~0.79 to ~0.21
+while the privileged solver stays at ~0.70), but a cheap RL recipe that clears the scripted
+ceiling has not been demonstrated yet. There is 0.49 of headroom between the best
+observation-only controller and the privileged solver; closing it most likely needs longer
+training, longer histories in the policy input, or a learned estimator, not a
+change to the task.
+
+## Reproduce
+
+```bash
+python3 tools/eval_policies.py --policy reference --seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --per 8 --workers 8
+python3 tools/eval_policies.py --policy refport   --seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --per 8 --workers 8
+python3 tools/train_ppo.py --base refport --parallel-eval --priv-shaping --steps 300000
+NIST_SCRIPTED_FIXTURES=/path/to/private/onnx pytest tests/test_scripted_regression.py
+```
+
+`tests/test_scripted_regression.py` asserts every scripted ONNX in
+`$NIST_SCRIPTED_FIXTURES` and the in-repo obs-only scripted controller score ≤ 0.30; it is
+skipped when the fixture directory is absent (fixtures are not part of the public repo).

+@dataclass
+class SlotSpec:
+    """One board slot: cross-section family, size and board-local pose.
+
+    ``size`` is the inscribed diameter (across flats). ``params`` holds the family
+    parameters (``aspect`` for rect/stadium, ``n`` for ngon, ``flat`` for dflat,
+    ``taper`` for trapezoid).

+    y: float
+    yaw: float
+    params: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

+    @property
+    def r(self) -> float:
+        return self.size / 2
+
+    def polygon(self) -> list[tuple[float, float]] | None:
+        """Convex cross-section (counter-clockwise, slot frame). None for round."""
+        return shape_polygon(self.shape, self.r, self.params)
+
+    def outer_radius(self) -> float:
+        poly = self.polygon()
+        if poly is None:
+            return self.r
+        return max(math.hypot(x, y) for x, y in poly)
+
+    def half_width_y(self) -> float:
+        """Half-extent along the slot-frame y axis (the gripper closing axis)."""
+        poly = self.polygon()
+        if poly is None:
+            return self.r
+        return max(abs(y) for _, y in poly)
+
+    def symmetry(self) -> int:
+        """Rotational symmetry order (0 = any yaw). Privileged tooling only."""
+        if self.shape == "round":
+            return 0
+        if self.shape == "rect":
+            return 4 if abs(self.params.get("aspect", 1.0) - 1.0) < 1e-6 else 2
+        if self.shape == "ngon":

+        if self.shape == "stadium":
+            return 2
+        return 1
+
+    def public(self) -> dict:

+            "yaw": round(float(self.yaw), 6),
+            "params": {k: (round(float(v), 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in self.params.items()},
+        }

+def shape_polygon(shape: str, r: float, params: dict) -> list[tuple[float, float]] | None:
+    if shape == "round":
+        return None
+    if shape == "rect":
+        ax = r * float(params.get("aspect", 1.0))
+        return [(ax, -r), (ax, r), (-ax, r), (-ax, -r)]
+    if shape == "ngon":
+        n = int(params["n"])
+        rc = r / math.cos(math.pi / n)
+        return [(rc * math.cos(2 * math.pi * k / n + math.pi / n), rc * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / n + math.pi / n)) for k in range(n)]
+    if shape == "dflat":
+        # Circle of radius r with a flat chord at x = flat * r (size = 2 r).
+        f = float(params["flat"])
+        th0 = math.acos(f)
+        m = 14
+        pts = [(r * math.cos(th0 + (2 * math.pi - 2 * th0) * k / m), r * math.sin(th0 + (2 * math.pi - 2 * th0) * k / m)) for k in range(m + 1)]
+        return pts
+    if shape == "stadium":
+        half = r * float(params.get("aspect", 1.5))
+        L = half - r
+        pts = []
+        m = 6
+        for k in range(m + 1):
+            a = -math.pi / 2 + math.pi * k / m
+            pts.append((L + r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a)))
+        for k in range(m + 1):

+            pts.append((-L + r * math.cos(a), r * math.sin(a)))
+        return pts
+    if shape == "trapezoid":

+    if family == "dflat":

+def _poly_walls(poly: list[tuple[float, float]], clearance: float, z0: float, hz: float, prefix: str) -> list[str]:
+    """One box wall per edge of a convex polygon, inner face offset outward by ``clearance``."""
+    out = []
+    n = len(poly)
+    for k in range(n):
+        x0, y0 = poly[k]
+        x1, y1 = poly[(k + 1) % n]
+        ex, ey = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
+        L = math.hypot(ex, ey)
+        if L < 1e-6:
+            continue
+        nx, ny = ey / L, -ex / L  # outward normal for counter-clockwise order
+        mx, my = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2
+        if nx * mx + ny * my < 0:
+            nx, ny = -nx, -ny
+        off = clearance + WALL_T / 2
+        cx, cy = mx + nx * off, my + ny * off
+        th = math.atan2(ny, nx)
+        out.append(
+            f'<geom name="{prefix}{k}" type="box" pos="{cx:.6f} {cy:.6f} {z0}" '
+            f'euler="0 0 {th:.6f}" size="{WALL_T / 2} {L / 2 + WALL_T * 0.5:.6f} {hz}" class="fixed"/>'
+        )
+    return out

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+"""v0.5.0 generalization hardening: per-episode board layout and peg shapes.
+
+There is no fixed slot table: slot positions, slot yaw, cross-section family and size
+are drawn per episode, and the observation carries no shape label. These tests pin
+that, plus the geometric validity of the drawn layouts.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "referee"))
+from nist_sim import conditions  # noqa: E402
+from nist_sim.conditions import LAYOUT_WALL, N_SLOTS, sample_episodes  # noqa: E402
+from nist_sim.env import ACT_DIM, PEG_FEAT, PROPRIO_DIM, Episode  # noqa: E402
+
+PEG0 = PROPRIO_DIM + ACT_DIM
+
+
+def _layouts(seed=0, per=4):
+    _, eps = sample_episodes(seed, per)
+    return eps
+
+
+def test_layout_varies_per_episode():
+    """No shared template: slot centres of two episodes do not line up."""
+    eps = _layouts()
+    assert all(len(c.slots) == N_SLOTS for c in eps)
+    gaps = []
+    for a, b in zip(eps, eps[1:]):
+        pa = np.array([[s.x, s.y] for s in a.slots])
+        pb = np.array([[s.x, s.y] for s in b.slots])
+        d = np.linalg.norm(pa[:, None, :] - pb[None, :, :], axis=-1).min(axis=1)
+        gaps.append(float(np.median(d)))
+    # A fixed table would give ~0 mm; random layouts leave a cm-scale median gap.
+    assert np.median(gaps) > 0.008, np.median(gaps)
+
+
+def test_slot_index_carries_no_geometry():
+    """Mean position of slot k over many episodes is near the board centre for every k."""
+    eps = []
+    for seed in range(4):
+        eps += _layouts(seed, 8)
+    pos = np.array([[[s.x, s.y] for s in c.slots] for c in eps])  # (E, 8, 2)
+    mean_per_slot = pos.mean(axis=0)
+    assert float(np.abs(mean_per_slot).max()) < 0.02, mean_per_slot
+
+
+def test_layout_slots_do_not_overlap():
+    for c in _layouts(1, 8):
+        for i, a in enumerate(c.slots):
+            for b in c.slots[i + 1 :]:
+                d = math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
+                assert d >= a.outer_radius() + b.outer_radius() + 2 * LAYOUT_WALL, (a, b)
+
+
+def test_live_shape_variety_continuous():
+    """Several families, continuous sizes, no single dominant family."""
+    eps = []
+    for seed in range(3):
+        eps += _layouts(seed, 8)
+    fam = [p.shape() for c in eps for p in c.pegs]
+    sizes = {round(p.diameter(), 8) for c in eps for p in c.pegs}
+    assert set(fam) == set(conditions.LIVE_SHAPES)
+    assert max(fam.count(f) for f in set(fam)) / len(fam) < 0.45
+    assert len(sizes) > 0.9 * len(fam)
+
+
+def test_obs_has_no_shape_label():
+    """Peg features 8:12 are slot-yaw estimate + outer size, identical layout for every family."""
+    _, eps = sample_episodes(2, 2)
+    for i, c in enumerate(eps[:6]):
+        ss = np.random.SeedSequence([2, 0x5245, i])
+        r1, r2 = (np.random.default_rng(x) for x in ss.spawn(2))
+        e = Episode(c, r1)
+        o = e.observe(r2)
+        for k, peg in enumerate(c.pegs):
+            f = o[PEG0 + k * PEG_FEAT : PEG0 + (k + 1) * PEG_FEAT]
+            assert abs(f[8] ** 2 + f[9] ** 2 - 1.0) < 1e-3  # sin/cos of an angle, not one-hot
+            assert f[11] == 0.0
+            assert abs(f[12] / 50 - peg.diameter()) < 1e-5
+
+
+def test_slot_yaw_estimate_is_biased_vs_peg_yaw():
+    """The slot-yaw channel and peg-yaw channel do not share one offset (per-peg residual)."""
+    _, eps = sample_episodes(3, 4)
+    hard = [c for c in eps if c.difficulty_tier == "hard"]
+    mags = [abs(d) for c in hard for d in c.peg_yaw_delta_list]
+    assert mags and min(mags) >= conditions.PEG_YAW_DELTA[0] - 1e-9
+
+
+def test_aligned_pegs_seat_in_every_family():
+    """Geometry sanity: a peg dropped aligned onto its hole seats, for every family."""
+    import mujoco
+
+    from nist_sim.env import PEG_LEN, _yaw_quat
+
+    seen = set()
+    _, eps = sample_episodes(4, 2)
+    for c in eps:
+        e = Episode(c, np.random.default_rng(0))
+        for i in range(e.n_pegs):
+            hx, hy = e.slot_xy[i]
+            e._set_free(e.peg_qadr[i], e.peg_vadr[i], [hx, hy, PEG_LEN / 2 + 0.0015], _yaw_quat(e.slot_yaw[i]))
+        mujoco.mj_forward(e.model, e.data)
+        e.target[:] = [c.board_xy[0], c.board_xy[1], 0.15, e.target[3]]
+        for _ in range(25):
+            e.step(np.array([0, 0, 1, 0, 1.0]))
+        for i, p in enumerate(c.pegs):
+            assert e.seated_now[i], (p.shape(), p.spec.public())
+            seen.add(p.shape())
+    assert seen == set(conditions.LIVE_SHAPES)

+"""v0.5.0 generalization hardening: hand-coded controllers must stay well below the
+learned / privileged range.
+
+- ``ObsOnlyScripted`` (referee/nist_sim/policies.py) and the obs-only reference port
+  (tools/obs_refport.py) are always checked.
+- Additional scripted ONNX policies can be checked from a local directory given by
+  ``NIST_SCRIPTED_FIXTURES`` (every ``*.onnx`` in it). These fixtures are kept
+  outside the repository; the test is skipped when the variable is unset.
+
+Each must score <= SCRIPTED_CEILING on a fixed 16-episode slice of the live mix.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import sys
+from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "referee"))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
+
+SCRIPTED_CEILING = 0.30
+SEED, PER = 11, 2  # 16 episodes, all tiers
+
+
+def _episode_score(kind: str, i: int) -> float:
+    sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "referee"), str(ROOT / "tools")]
+    from nist_sim.conditions import episode_seed_sequence, sample_episodes
+    from nist_sim.env import Episode
+    from nist_sim.policies import ObsOnlyScripted
+    from nist_sim.scoring import episode_score
+
+    _, conds = sample_episodes(SEED, PER)
+    c = conds[i]
+    r1, r2 = (np.random.default_rng(s) for s in episode_seed_sequence(SEED, i).spawn(2))
+    e = Episode(c, r1)
+    if kind == "refport":
+        from obs_refport import solve_obs_episode
+
+        return float(solve_obs_episode(e, r2)["score"])
+    if kind == "obs_scripted":
+        pol = ObsOnlyScripted()
+        act = pol.act
+    else:
+        import onnxruntime as ort
+
+        so = ort.SessionOptions()
+        so.intra_op_num_threads = 1
+        sess = ort.InferenceSession(kind, so, providers=["CPUExecutionProvider"])
+        name = sess.get_inputs()[0].name
+
+        def act(o):
+            x = np.round(np.asarray(o, np.float64), 6).astype(np.float32)[None]
+            a = np.asarray(sess.run(None, {name: x})[0], dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1)[:5]
+            return a if a.shape == (5,) and np.all(np.isfinite(a)) else np.zeros(5)
+
+    while not e.done:
+        e.step(np.clip(act(e.observe(r2)), -1, 1))
+    return float(
+        episode_score(e.peg_seated_at_end(), e.peg_first_seat_steps(), c.max_steps, e.action_l2 / max(1, e.steps))
+    )
+
+
+def _mean_score(kind: str) -> float:
+    n = 8 * PER
+    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(4, os.cpu_count() or 1)) as ex:
+        return float(np.mean(list(ex.map(_episode_score, [kind] * n, range(n)))))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["obs_scripted", "refport"])
+def test_builtin_scripted_controllers_stay_low(kind):
+    s = _mean_score(kind)
+    assert s <= SCRIPTED_CEILING, f"{kind} scored {s:.3f} > {SCRIPTED_CEILING}"
+
+
+def _fixture_policies() -> list[str]:
+    d = os.environ.get("NIST_SCRIPTED_FIXTURES")
+    if not d or not Path(d).is_dir():
+        return []
+    return sorted(str(p) for p in Path(d).glob("*.onnx"))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not _fixture_policies(), reason="NIST_SCRIPTED_FIXTURES not set (private fixtures)")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "path", _fixture_policies() or ["none"], ids=[f"fixture{i}" for i in range(max(1, len(_fixture_policies())))]
+)
+def test_fixture_scripted_policies_stay_low(path):
+    s = _mean_score(path)
+    assert s <= SCRIPTED_CEILING, f"fixture scored {s:.3f} > {SCRIPTED_CEILING}"
